listings.description: Rose Palezia is not a decorative rose. It is an architectural, assertive rose. A maximalist rose, sculpted in light and slowly revealed through shadow.. A rose imagined as an immersion into a reinvented Italian palace, luminous on the façade, deep within its salons, mysterious through its galleries.. It opens with a vivid, radiant freshness, almost crystalline. Then it moves through the material, gaining texture, depth and presence. Finally, it settles into shadow, wrapped in dark woods and patinated materials with warm, elegant reflections.. Rose Palezia tells the story of this transition: from light into shadow, from radiance into depth, from freshness into sensuality. A rose of contrast and metamorphosis, between contemporary opulence and timeless elegance. .

A Woody Gourmand fragrance with the unmistakable Dusita signature: indulgent and enveloping, yet luminous and refined.. Mocha Absolu pairs the richness of Arabica coffee and dark chocolate with an unexpected lift of Thai tea. . Toasted almond, caramelised milk and vanilla bring a smooth warmth to the heart, settling into sandalwood, tonka bean and benzoin. Rich and enveloping, yet never heavy - a gourmand with a distinctive Dusita touch. . . . "To mark Dusita's 10th anniversary, I wanted to honour our House's emotional origins. Mocha Absolu was inspired by a cherished childhood memory. I remember returning from school to the aroma of hot mocha and Thai tea, finding my father writing at his desk. Later, he began preparing those drinks for me too, a simple gesture of love I have never forgotten. To this day, their scent instantly reminds me of the warmth of our family home. I hope Mocha Absolu offers everyone that same sweet feeling of coming home.". - Pissara Umavijani . . . .

listings.rawTitle: The Story of a Decade Perfume Set 8 x 8.5ml
listings.description: Created as a limited edition to celebrate A Decade Of Perfume, this exceptional set unfolds like a graphic novel. . Illustrated by French comic book artist Vincent Mallié, the story retraces the Maison’s first decade in fragrance through the eyes and memories of Marc-Antoine Barrois. . As the box opens from the top and sides, each panel reveals a new chapter: the defining encounters, the birth of each creation, the decisive milestones, but also the doubts, setbacks and unexpected turns that shaped the journey. Successes and failures, moments of joy and sadness, creative intuition and perseverance all come together in a sincere and deeply personal story. . More than a discovery set, L’HISTOIRE DE 10 ANS DE PARFUMS is an illustrated testimony to ten years of creation, emotion and adventure, an anniversary object designed to be unfolded, explored and collected. . . Conceived as a journey through the Maison's creative universe, this new set invites each fragrance to reveal its own story: from the timeless leather elegance of B683, to the mineral radiance of Ganymede, the volcanic sensuality of ENCELADE, the solar optimism of TILIA, the luminous floral purity of ALDEBARAN, and the deeper, more intense expressions of the Maison's three Extraits..

listings.description: An invitation to step into the dreamlike universe of the Maison Marc-Antoine Barrois through a curated selection of five Eau de Parfum creations in a generous travel format: 5 x 8.5 ml.. Designed as a premium discovery set, IMAGINARIUM allows clients to explore the olfactory worlds created by Marc-Antoine Barrois and Quentin Bisch, from contemporary elegance to celestial inspirations and singular, memorable signatures.. This new set invites each fragrance to reveal its own story: from the timeless leather elegance of B683, to the mineral radiance of Ganymede, the volcanic sensuality of ENCELADE, the solar optimism of TILIA, and the luminous floral purity of ALDEBARAN.. Its illustrated golden sleeve, enhanced with refined finishing details such as gold lamination and positive and negative embossing, transforms the set into a precious, collectible object. This set contains five of the maison's Eau de Parfums each in 8.5ml spray bottle..

"For a long time I felt that geranium deserved its own perfume. I wanted the material to breathe: leaf, flower, herb and powder all present at the same time. . The breakthrough came when I trusted a classical triangle again: green herbs, tonka, and a vanilla warmth. With brightness above, and warmth underneath, geranium suddenly had the space it needed to open and become rounder, whilst keeping its vivid floral-green character. . I let it remain geranium." . - Andy Tauer. Fresh, bright and aromatic in the opening, warmer in the heart, and polished with the refined Tauer signature in the dry down, GERANIUM Absolue is a unisex, green-aromatic floral that has freshness with structure, and elegance with character.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Coriander, Rosemary, Lavender. Heart Notes: Bourbon Geranium, Green Leaf Facets, Rosy Floral Facets, Soft Powder . Base Notes: Tonka Warmth, Vanilla, Cistus Labdanum, Oakmoss, Soft Woods, Musk .

The House of Creed unlocks Iris Debonair, an addictive fougère floral fragrance where the precision of British tailoring meets the art of French Haute Perfumery.. A luminous bergamot, co-infused with absinthe leaves, opens with intentional charm. The finest Creed-sourced English lavender from Kent brings crisp, herbaceous clarity. Deeper in the palette, French iris pallida from Les Landes, grown for over three years, casts magnetic shades of pale blue.. This is a fragrance worn as a seal of elegance. “Iris Debonair”, pronounced with a French accent, also echoes The House of Creed’s rich Franco-British heritage. Rooted in the old French expression “de bon air”, meaning “of good disposition and lineage”, the term refers to a magnetic and self-assured character who needs no validation, much like the aesthetes who first inspired this Haute Perfumery creation..

Oud Supermassive reveals an unapologetically bold interpretation of the mythical ingredient. From the very first notes, oud takes centre stage, enveloped in olibanum and supple leather. Its powerful character is illuminated by a delicate hint of osmanthus, peach, passion fruit, bringing a subtle, almost solar brightness. In the base, tobacco extends the warmth of the sacred wood, leaving a deep, sensual, and lingering trail on the skin.. A personal vision of oud, one that bridges cultures and contrasts, merging ancestral depth with contemporary freshness. A new way of creating, where opposites collide to reveal perfect harmony.. Oud Supermassive is a co-creation between Arnaud Poulain and Julien Rasquinet..

A latex and leather 'oud-style' scent. A perfumer’s take on neon-soaked nightlife, the leather scene and raw, nocturnal behaviour. With notes of latex, neoprene leather, black shoe shine, hydrocarboresin and styrax. . October 1996, New York City. . In the neon-soaked nights of downtown New York, a young perfumer roams the city after dark, chasing inspiration. The humid air carries hints of spilled booze, cigarette smoke, and the sweat of bodies moving in underground clubs. He meets a man who drifts through the scene like a ghost, his scent a mix of neoprene, leather boots, and something undefinable. Drawn into the city’s after-hours underbelly - where lust and abandon blend into an intoxicating mix - he absorbs the essence of the night. But as he does, he realizes he’s not just capturing that prevalent, sexual scent - he’s losing himself in it..

Beneath the elegant curve of Nash’s cream-coloured terraces lies a green sanctuary where London's heartbeat softens into a whisper. In the delicate waking of spring, an ethereal canopy of white and pink cherry blossoms unfurls along the avenues, showering the paths with drifting petals.. This ephemeral beauty gives way to the heavy, sweet accord of twelve thousand blooming roses in Queen Mary’s quiet paths, mingling with the distant, wild calls of the zoo and the soft applause of an open-air stage. As the sun dips low, casting long shadows across the boating lake, the park's gentle paths ascend to Primrose Hill - where the vast city skyline unfolds like a quiet promise under the evening sky.. Imagine a fragrance that feels like a velvet cloak draped over a tropical twilight.. Cherry Lane opens with an unexpected, intoxicating contrast: the bright, syrupy indulgence of ripe black cherries dissolved into a deep, full-bodied pour of red wine.. Just as the fruit and vine take hold, a creamy undercurrent of coconut softens the sharp edges, bleeding seamlessly into a warm, sensual base of rich Australian sandalwood and mysterious, dark oud. It is a bold, nocturnal scent - sweet yet smoky, comforting yet deeply sophisticated - built for someone who commands a room without saying a word..

listings.rawTitle: An Evening with Memoirs of a Perfume Collector
listings.description: An Evening with Memoirs of a Perfume Collector. Thursday 30 July | 5.00–7.00 pm . Join us for an intimate evening with Akbar Khan , one half of the visionary partnership that founded Memoirs of a Perfume Collector , alongside Shadi Samra , the celebrated nose and perfumer behind their latest release, Cherry Lane .. In just a few short years, Memoirs of a Perfume Collector has established itself as one of Britain's most exciting fragrance brands, captivating perfume lovers with evocative scents inspired by travel, memory and discovery. Over drinks and conversation, Aki will reflect on the realities of launching and nurturing an independent fragrance house in today's market, sharing the triumphs, challenges and unexpected moments that have shaped the brand's remarkable journey.. Joining him will be Shadi Samra, one of the industry's most respected noses, who will offer a glimpse behind the curtain of modern perfumery. From the spark of an idea to the final composition, he will reveal some of the secrets behind creating fragrances that resonate with collectors and enthusiasts alike.. Chaired by our very own in-house expert - guests will also have the opportunity to discover the stories behind Cherry Lane and other favourites from the collection, before putting their own questions to our speakers.. The event will run from 5.00 pm until 7.00 pm . Tickets cost £25 per person , redeemable against any purchase from the Memoirs of a Perfume Collector collection made on the evening.. We look forward to welcoming you for what promises to be a fascinating exploration of creativity, craftsmanship and contemporary perfumery..

Luisant evokes an inner light. Haze, an atmospheric veil where contours dissolve. Together they name a rare balance between clarity and diffusion, between presence and transparency.. At the heart of Luisant Haze , a reinterpreted tuberose: softened, diffuse, luminous. Far from this flower's traditional opulence, Thomas de Monaco reimagines it in an airy and radiant register, as if filtered through the mist of a clear morning.. The opening is fresh and delicate: wild strawberry brings a natural, almost tender fruitiness, enlivened by cardamom and pink pepper which add a light, transparent spice. No flash, no ostentation, just a shimmer.. At the heart, the tuberose blooms within a cotton candy accord of airy, enveloping sweetness, free from any heaviness. It is a new kind of softness, closer to memory than sensation.. The base reveals the sophistication of the structure: saffron adds a discreet golden warmth, Amber Xtreme a transparent ambered depth, tonka bean its creamy softness, and white musk extends the sillage in a skin-on-skin accord, constantly alive.. As its creator intended: an aura rather than a projection. A veil of light that accompanies the skin, discreet, intimate, unforgettable. A niche floral musk fragrance for those who inhabit their sillage like a luminous second skin..

Inspired by a quiet London morning at 7:15 AM - the feeling of walking through the city with fresh air, warm coffee, soft florals, and sunlight beginning to appear. . The composition also carries subtle nuances of peppermint tea and lemon drizzle cake. .

Royal Nawaf marks the third chapter between Ormonde Jayne and Nawaf Aljamea, celebrating Ormonde Jayne’s home, The Royal Arcade, for centuries a vital passage through Mayfair, London’s epicentre of ultraluxury.. Following the success of Oud Nawaf and Nawaf Zaffran, Ormonde Jayne now adopt a new identity which reframes the dialogue and is truly regal.. Entering with a vivid blood orange, gently bittersweet, entwined with the dark juiciness of damson, together they create a polished and powerful overture.. At its heart, an elegant white muguet brings a clean luminous lift, while black iris introduces a cool powdered depth.. The soul of Royal Nawaf is sensual and assured. Framboise adds a crimson nuance, woven seamlessly into patchouli for gravitas. Tonka bean absolute settles the composition with an ambery warmth. Presence rather than proclamation. A fitting homage to the home of Ormonde Jayne in The Royal Arcade..

California Love opens with an immediate, radiant explosion of passionfruit, providing a tropical, tangy sweetness that is instantly uplifting. Bergamot, lemon, and orange create a sparkling, mouth-watering experience that feels like a cool breeze on a humid day.. The Mojito and blackcurrant introduce a minty freshness and a hint of sugared lime, perfectly complemented by the tart, dark-berry nuance of blackcurrant. Together, they create a cocktail-hour vibe.. Clean musk and velvety ambroxan come through at the base with a clean, modern, skin-like warmth, while oakmoss adds an essential touch of earthy, forest floor and classic structure. This grounded finish ensures the fragrance lingers with a sophisticated, captivating, tropical botanical trail..

L’Air du Jardin Caché is a unisex floral perfume with a bright opening, a vivid floral heart, and a calm woody amber base. Concentrated at 25% fragrance oil, it combines richness with clarity and presence. Released as part of the 21st anniversary of Tauer Perfumes, the bottle label shows the number 21. . "I have always loved the presence of hyacinth, not as something decorative or simply spring-like, but as something vivid, green, elegant, and full of character. It carries light, but it also carries shape. That tension has stayed with me for a long time. . With L’Air du Jardin Caché, I wanted to work from tha t love of hyacinth and from my equal love of classical perfumery. I wanted the perfume to feel rooted in the great tradition of classical French artistic perfume, with richness, proportion, and beauty, yet not become trapped by the old limits of the genre. . The aim was to create something genuinely new: a floral perfume with refinement and trad ition behind it, but with a freer, more vivid movement and a more open, modern sense of air. Something classical in spirit, but not retrospective. Something that keeps its elegance while breaking the usual limits of what a floral perfume is expected to be." - Andy Tauer, perfumer. .

Unique yet familiar, just like every icon, capable of encompassing the surrounding world in it. Experiences and emotions merge, tributes and roots, all of which are essential for a sound future. That’s why it’s all there blended together: spices and exotic fruits, the Italian spirit of bergamot and iris, combined with the precious Taïf rose, the oud of an aspiring horizon, the sure landing place of white musk.. Contrasting, just as the life of the Venetian districts on different sides of the legendary Rialto Bridge. Step one: the famous market with its smells of fresh fruits and exotic spices. Step two: St Mark’s Square, the iconic rendezvous point with its dapper salty air and silver wisps of tobacco smoke. A transparent yet rich, the smell of The Floating City..

Time is still, for a moment. Expectations, murmurs, excitement. Then astonishment. From here, it seems like everything has been contrived and invented, yet nothing is fake. Theatre. Full of passions, intrigues, crimes. Discoveries and hope. Every day is full of possibilities. The future becomes a reality. The past, history: just a voice to listen to. Eden smells of new fruits, with lilies and magnolias lighting it up with purity and whiteness. Water, all around.. Dedicated to the Teatro La Fenice and dressed in scarlet velvet, the same as the curtain that hides the main stage, Luca Gritti’s Fenice is a homage to the most famous Italian opera house. Intro, rising, climax: the perfume’s two poles are a powerful passion fruit note and honeyed amber accord masterfully sealed with a drop of fresh peach juice. The standing ovation ― and the sillage to remember..

Florian, The Gritti’s ruby. An extraordinary purity and full-bodied, deep burgundy shade that inspired the perfumer’s research of the Orient with its outstanding way of life, rich colours, and intoxicating smells.. The heart of the journey is a precious Laotian oud adorned with the spicy accents of cardamom and tempered by dramatic Taif rose nuances. A golden haze of incense mixed with white peppery ginger nuances add depth to the composition and lead it to a mellow, sensual woody sillage..

In the refined world of haute perfumery, where mystery and elegance intertwine, Muskaria is born. An olfactory treasure, both intimate and enigmatic, crafted for those who appreciate the rare and the refined. . For years, master perfumer Luca Gritti kept this scent as his personal signature, a fragrance reserved for himself alone. Now, as a gift to his devoted audience, he unveils its secrets. Muskaria is an opulent blend of noble musks, rare spices, and precious resins—deep, sophisticated, and irresistibly magnetic. More than just a fragrance, it is an invitation into Luca Gritti’s private world. . A scent of allure and confidence, wrapped in mystery, designed to be worn like a whispered secret on the skin. .

Lys Noir Extrait offers a richer, more intense expression of the original composition, emphasising the mysterious allure of its floral and woody accords.. The fragrance opens with a subtle yet intriguing note of Black Pepper, adding a touch of spice that sets the stage for the opulent heart. At its core, a bouquet of Lily, Indian Jasmine Absolute, Indian Tuberose Absolute, Broom Absolute, and Ylang Essence creates a heady and sophisticated floral arrangement. These notes blend harmoniously to evoke an atmosphere of elegance and intrigue.. The base is warm and deeply textured, featuring Vanilla, Sandalwood Essence, Incense, Cashmere Woods, and Amber. This combination adds depth and a smoky sweetness, enhancing the fragrance’s complexity and giving it a lasting, enveloping presence.. While staying true to the structure of the original, Lys Noir Extrait amplifies its darker and more opulent facets. The result is a fragrance that exudes refinement and mystery, with an enduring trail that leaves a captivating impression..

La Route d’Emeraude Extrait is a deeper and more concentrated interpretation of the original fragrance. By intensifying its floral and ambery notes, the Extrait version offers a richer and more enduring experience.. First, the fragrance begins with an inviting blend of Bergamot, Rose Oil, and a touch of Cinnamon, which adds warmth and a soft spiciness to the opening. Then, as the scent evolves, the heart reveals a luminous bouquet of Jasmine Sambac, Orange Flower, Tuberose, and the creamy richness of Ylang-Ylang. Jasmine Sambac, with its floral, voluptuous, and slightly animalistic aroma, brings sensual depth and femininity to the composition, enveloping it in velvety richness. Tuberose, on the other hand, offers its creamy, opulent, and intoxicating signature, amplifying the fragrance’s sensual allure. This floral bouquet creates a multifaceted heart, where delicate refinement meets bold intensity, capturing the very essence of femininity in its most captivating form.. At last, in the base, Amber, Benzoin, Vanilla, and Musk provide a smooth and velvety foundation. These notes create a soft, lingering warmth that unfolds gradually, enhancing the fragrance’s depth and character.. While the structure remains consistent with the Eau de Parfum, the higher concentration of the Extrait allows the floral heart to take on a more vivid and opulent quality. The result is a fragrance that feels intimate yet powerful, with a lasting presence that deepens over time..

The Gardénia Extrait is an indulgent interpretation of the original, showcasing the Gardenia flower with greater intensity and radiance. Known for its creamy and mesmerising fragrance, Gardenia embodies timeless allure and elegance. Furthermore, this captivating white flower enchants with its sweet, floral notes and delightful fruity undertones, making it a cherished symbol of grace. . Gardénia Extrait by Isabey offers a more concentrated and indulgent version of the classic Isabey Gardénia. While it shares the same olfactive pyramid as the Eau de Parfum, the Extrait amplifies the fragrance, revealing the Gardenia’s warm and velvety nuances more intensely.. To begin, the fragrance opens with a bright burst of Italian Tangerine, Ylang-Ylang Essence, and Absolute Orange Blossom, which create a lively and inviting introduction. Then, these vibrant top notes transition into the heart, where the velvety Gardenia is beautifully balanced by a bouquet of Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, and Iris. This harmonious blend evokes a sense of sophistication and refined beauty.. As the scent evolves, the base notes provide depth and sensuality. Finally, Indian Sandalwood Essence, Ambergris, and soft Musk anchor the fragrance, leaving a lingering and elegant trail. Together, these elements form a composition that feels both opulent and enduring..

Composed of a sunny, creamy, and narcotic white floral bouquet, Avant et Après by Isabey is lulled by a sea wind in a refreshing signature. The fragrance opens with Freesia lending a touch of floral grace and gentle sweetness to the composition, and Frangipani Flower, bringing sunshine and warmth. The heart unfolds with Jasmin Sambac, with its floral, voluptuous, sweet, and slightly animalistic scent. In the dry-down, Vanilla, Benzoin, and Musk emphasize the sweetness and intensity of the Tiare Flower.. “I wanted to interpret a Monoï Accord and Orange Blossom in an elegant style, a contrasted scent oscillating between contemporary opulence and freshness. . I was inspired by a walk along the seaside at dawn, the sensations of fresh wind caressing the face in the bright light of sunrise.” . For her first collaboration with Isabey, perfumer Marie Schnirer created a solar contemporary scent, a bouquet of feminine and sensual white flowers sublimated with salty notes: “Isabey inspires elegance, character, and femininity. It was therefore interesting for me to compose a large bouquet of white flowers. What could be more feminine and sensual?” .

Rue de la Paix by Isabey Paris is a sparkling white floral fragrance. It is a luxurious perfume that celebrates the Maison’s 100th anniversary. For this momentous occasion, Isabey has introduced a new scent to its Eau de Parfum collection. Rue de la Paix exudes elegance and timeless beauty in a rich, floral composition.. The fragrance is a masterful composition of noble materials, particularly featuring a bold bouquet of white flowers, including Narcissus, Tuberose, Lily, and Jasmine. Initially, the perfume opens with a juicy, realistic Peach note, adding a modern twist to the classic floral arrangement. This initial burst is followed by a sensual heart of intense floral notes, gradually blending into a rich, woody base with hints of Papyrus. Altogether, it creates a truly white floral fragrance, a signature of Isabey.. “Rue de la Paix combines the most beautiful flower essences with a playful and modern touch of Peach, evoking the effervescence of a glass of champagne. Moreover, its sophisticated trail pays homage to the floral notes of the 1920s and thus leaves a refined imprint reminiscent of an armful of flower petals, which seduces and enchants.” – Patrice Revillard, perfumer .

Prends-Moi by Isabey opens with an enticing blend of spicy Pink Pepper, elegantly complemented by the bright freshness of Bergamot and the luscious sweetness of Raspberry. As the fragrance unfolds, it leads to a dual heart where an innocent Rose encounters an extremely carnal Tuberose. In this captivating interplay, its allure gradually reveals a generous and profound character. The scent is intense, lavish, and deeply sensual, often described as narcotic in its richness.. Then, the Red Satin Lipstick Accord becomes the forbidden lover of Cocoa Absolute, which is effortlessly seduced in this game of love. This intriguing combination adds a layer of playful complexity, inviting exploration into the depths of desire. Subsequently, the composition is enriched by the creamy warmth of Sandalwood, providing a smooth and grounding foundation. Additionally, Amber weaves in a rich, glowing sensuality that enhances the overall experience, resulting in a decadent and alluring fragrance—bold, luxurious, and irresistibly seductive.. It’s Midnight in Paris. A man and a woman, once passionately entwined, find themselves reunited on a bridge, where the air is thick with memories. Their unique and carnal love envelops them, transporting their senses to a realm beyond reason. He enfolds her in his arms, inhaling her intoxicating fragrance. In this moment of intimacy, her red lips whisper softly, “Prends Moi…”. “I was inspired for this creation by the last moment before the ultimate act of love. The adrenaline, the warmth of the skin, a kiss on the neck, the chills. So I wanted to use bold and sensual raw materials, which represented a veiled eroticism.” – Luca Maffei, perfumer .

Gardenia, the epitome of elegance in perfumery, captivates with its creamy and mesmerising fragrance, evoking timeless allure and grace. A captivating and powerful white flower known for its sweet, persistent, and floral fragrance, with delightful fruity undertones. Despite its alluring scent, this bloom poses a unique challenge in the world of perfumery. Paradoxically, it remains elusive and difficult to faithfully capture through traditional distillation or extraction techniques.. . . . . . Truly luxurious, Gardénia by Isabey is a rare scent that perfectly captures the very essence of a solitary bloom. Stunningly true to the flower, the essential oil is made with pure Gardenia extract, complimented by some of nature’s most captivating aromas, including Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, Ylang-ylang, Orange Blossom, Ambergris, and Italian Tangerine.. The fragrance embarks on a white floral, ambery olfactory journey. Heady, yet deceptively soft, sensual, and warm, there is no doubt that this is a unique and timeless fragrance..

Lys Noir by Isabey is a mysterious, desirable fragrance dedicated to the modern elegant woman with glamorous style and charm, leaving an unforgettable trail wherever she passes. . As a ‘femme du monde’ signature, the fragrance affirms its style through an elegant Clair-obscure around the opulent and captivating scent of Lily. The Lily flower possesses an intriguing duality, both mysterious and delicate, yet emanating a strong and captivating aroma. Its fragrance of white flowers is soft and sweet, like a gentle whisper of elegance.. Stirred up by notes of Black Pepper, the fragrance develops its voluptuous trail through narcotic flowers: Tuberose and Narcissus imprint their spicy animal facets on this mysterious aura, where the Tuberose adds a layer of complexity and the Narcissus leaves a trail of intrigue and fascination.. In the dry down, Patchouli expands its dark, attractive power, weaving an intricate tapestry with the depth of Ebony Wood and the creamy richness of a Santal Milk Accord. This forbidden game is softly wrapped by a musky veil..

La Route d’Emeraude by Isabey is an elegant exploration of Jasmine Sambac, a flower known for its captivating and opulent nature. The fragrance showcases the rich, undulating qualities of Jasmine Sambac, presenting it as a timeless expression of femininity and refinement.. The fragrance opens with a refreshing burst of Bergamot, spiced subtly with Cinnamon, and softened by the gentle essence of Rose. These notes introduce the fragrance with brightness and warmth, gradually revealing a floral bouquet that feels both vibrant and inviting.. At the heart of La Route d’Emeraude is the seductive presence of Jasmine Sambac. Combined with the lush, white florals of Orange Flower and Tuberose, the scent develops a delicate yet powerful character. The addition of Ylang-Ylang adds a smooth, tropical nuance, creating a well-rounded floral composition that feels both rich and serene.. As the fragrance unfolds, it is anchored by a warm base of Amber and Benzoin, which lend a resinous depth. Vanilla contributes a soft sweetness, while Musk adds a subtle sensuality that lingers on the skin, creating an intimate and enveloping finish. Together, these base notes bring a sense of warmth and quiet sophistication.. La Route d’Emeraude draws inspiration from its origins, reflecting the scents and beauty of faraway lands. This modern edition nods to the past, capturing the essence of its journey through the “Emerald Triangle” while offering a fragrance that feels contemporary yet steeped in tradition..

Fleur Nocturne by Jean Jacques presents a captivating floral bouquet that harmoniously blends white flowers and fruity notes, all resting on a sensual base. Jean Jacques, a master of refined compositions, carefully crafted this fragrance to evoke a sense of elegance and depth.. The fragrance opens with the bright, uplifting notes of Mandarin, complemented by the delicate sweetness of Apricot Tree Flower and White Peach. This refreshing combination brings to mind the joy of experiencing a scent crafted from noble and precious ingredients, inviting you into its intricate world.. As it evolves, Fleur Nocturne reveals a heart rich with Jasmine, Magnolia, and Gardenia. These three florals, known for their rarity in high-quality perfumes, create an intoxicating floral character that is both creamy and lush. The interplay of these notes brings an air of sophistication, drawing the wearer into a fragrant garden at dusk.. The fragrance settles into a warm and inviting base. Here, Solar Notes impart a radiant glow, while Vanilla adds a layer of comforting sweetness. Patchouli introduces earthy, sensual undertones, culminating in a powerful yet elegant trail. This combination offers a balanced contrast, enhancing the overall experience of the fragrance..

Patch Absolue is a reinterpretation of Tauerville Patch Flash, in higher concentration and with a changed formula for a fuller, more lasting patchouli signature. . Patch Absolue opens with a boozy, spiced hit, cinnamon and clove wrapped in a warm, almost liqueur-like glow, then settles into a deeper, more textured patchouli. . Built around 40% natural patchouli oils, it balances earthy richness with a creamy floral lift and a resinous warmth. .

"To celebrate ten years of creation, I wanted to return to the essentials: a fragrance that embodies our quest for elevation and fulfilment. We only have one life to rise and become better. This fragrance is the culmination of a decade of work, weaving together the essence of our icons - the luminous pear of Couleur Primaire, the woody and spicy vanilla of Rose Supercritique, and the depth of sesame and tobacco from Ambre Superfluide." - Arnaud Poulain . . A fragrance for those who rise.. Life is an ascent , an invitation to grow, to learn, to become.. Like trees reaching for the skies, like mountains brushing the clouds, we are meant to rise.. To rise is to move forward, to explore, to create.. It is to draw closer to oneself, step by step. It is to turn every effort into momentum, every silence into clarity.. In the mountains, altitude transforms us: the gaze expands, the breath steadies, the heart finds its anchor.. It is an elevation of body, mind, and soul.. This new Opus captures that sensation: a gentle light, a milky cloud, a cottony freshness.. A fragrance like a new breath.. Reach new heights. .

The Soul of the Emirates, bottled.. For the first time in the United Arab Emirates, the true scent of the Ghaf tree - the nation's legacy tree - has been captured and crafted into perfume. This is not a fantasy. This is nature, memory, and culture distilled.. In a groundbreaking extraction project, The Scent Library used advanced scent-capturing machines to trace the soul of Al Ghaf - found in the deserts, near their farms, beside majlis gatherings. This tree was once the shade of the ancestors of the UAE. A place where grandfathers shared coffee, and grandmothers taught wisdom. Its leaves were nature’s cleansing tool, its presence a silent comfort in the harshest lands.. AL GHAF is not just a perfume. It’s a return. A revival. A tribute.. Crafted by master perfumer Kevin Mathys, Al Ghaf is built on earthy strength and dry elegance.. A powerful, dry scent that carries the dignity of the past with the refinement of today.. From the heart of the desert to the palm of your hand - this is the UAE in essence.. . . Top Notes: Radiant amber, Yellow florals Heart Notes: Warm leather, Sacred resin Base Notes: Deep woods, Amber veil.

Experience untamed elegance with a vetiver expression inspired by an English garden party wandering into the wild.. Wild Vetiver is a fragrance off the beaten path, walking the line between precise refinement and nature. Born from noble roots yet spirited in its freedom, this sculpted composition reveals a vibrant tension between sophistication and wilderness. Opening with the spiced vibrancy of hand-harvested timur berry, the heart unfolds as rose centifolia rambles freely. At the base, vetiver casts a woody trail, grounding the composition with modern elegance.. This is an enchanting journey through an aristocratic garden, where halcyon moments and the joy of missing out drift through the air..

Tonka Kumaru is a gourmand, sensual creation that reveals the tonka bean in all its depth. Every facet is carefully shaped, revealed, and amplified to express its singularity.. The fragrance unfolds with almondy notes of tonka lifted by the freshness of bergamot and the spiciness of cardamom.. In the heart, roasted barley and hay absolute enhance tonka’s dry, warm nuances, while cedar leaf brings structure, depth, and texture to the composition. . In the base, the roasted tonka bean fully unfolds. Elevated by raw Madagascan vanilla, its gourmand and milky facets shine through. Paired with amber and musks, it gains intensity, sensuality, and a lingering, enveloping warmth.. Tonka Kumaru is a modern tribute to an exceptional raw material, where each note is crafted to reveal and amplify the tonka bean’s full richness and complexity.. . Top Notes: Bergamot essential oil, Bitter almond extract, Cardamom essential oil. Heart Notes: Roasted barley extract, Hay absolute, Cedar leaf. Base Notes: Roasted tonka bean extract, Vanilla resinoid, Amber, Musks.

Âme de Fleur is inspired by the anemone flower, a symbol of desire, transformation, and eternal love.. In Greek mythology, the anemone was born from the tears of Aphrodite, goddess of love, as she mourned her lost lover Adonis. From this divine sorrow bloomed a delicate flower, forever tied to beauty, loss, and devotion.. In this fragrance story, the anemone becomes a living soul. She dances through hues of blue, green, and violet, her petals moving in a sensual metamorphosis.. She seduces, surrenders, and steals the scent of other blossoms. By day, she opens with intimacy; by night, she folds inward like an envelope cradling her fears.. She is the longing to love without expectation. She is vulnerability, elegance, and strength.. She is the Soul of the Flower, Âme de Fleur..

YUMA – The Elixir of Balance . Balance is a state of being: grounded, calm, and conscious. Like the Swiss Alps, it rises above the clouds while remaining deeply rooted in the earth. It preserves the stillness of alpine lakes, the purity of the air, and the quiet strength of the mountains, as the scent of Swiss mint drifts through the alpine breeze. In this balance, nature and self become one. . YUMA, named after its key components, is a short form of Yuzu–Mint — a metaphor for freshness, clarity, and harmony.. . Fragrance Composition . It preserves the stillness of alpine lakes, the purity of the air, and the quiet strength of the mountains, as the scent of Swiss mint drifts through the alpine breeze. In this balance, nature and self become one. . YUMA, named after its key components, is a short form of Yuzu–Mint — a metaphor for freshness, clarity, and harmony.. . Fragrance Composition . Top Notes: Swiss mint, Peppermint, Yuzu, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Alpine breeze accord, Edelweiss, Ginger, Cashmeran. Base Notes: Dry amber, Vetiver, Musk, Patchouli.

Named after the Arabic word for strong, intense, powerful, SHADID is a bold oriental fragrance with depth, elegance, and an uncompromising character. Rich and expressive yet refined, SHADID explores contrasts such as darkness and light, power and restraint, sensuality and air. It is an oriental fragrance with a strong presence and a soul.. SHADID was inspired by a drive through the desert from Los Angeles to Las Vegas. Wide blue skies, endless horizons, heat, silence, and solitude form a nearly mystical experience where memories surface, colours intensify, and time seems suspended. These impressions merge with recollections of journeys through oriental landscapes, including Saudi Arabia. Rich, warm, and deeply evocative, SHADID captures a feeling of vastness and intensity, tempered by calm and clarity.. At the heart of SHADID lies Nagarmotha, revealed in all its facets: woody, smoky, ambery, musky. It evokes the depth and richness often associated with oud. The composition opens with animalic leather and spice, then deepens into a rich and textured middle before settling into a dark yet radiant base. Creamy sandalwood, glowing ambergris, dry cedarwood, and a restrained touch of vanilla create lift and luminosity, balancing the darker elements and giving the fragrance an airy inner light. SHADID is powerful but never loud. Elegant, composed, and persistent.. . Top Notes Spices, Animalic Leather Coriander, Castoreum. Heart Notes Woody, Smoky, Musky Nagarmotha, Palisander, Animalic Musks. Base Notes Creamy, Dry, Luminous Sandalwood, Ambergris, Vanilla, Dry Cedarwood.

A luminous floral reverie . Time often lulls us into believing we have endless moments to embrace life's joys. Yet, the universe occasionally places obstacles in our path, urging us to pause, reflect, and seek solace within our most cherished memories. . Tuberose has been a constant in Neela Vermeire's life, intertwined with the fragrant tapestry of tropical blossoms. From childhood to each return to India, the vibrant flower markets have deepened her connection to this queen of flowers, etching its lush, opulent scent into her soul. . With Eshal, Neela Vermeire has crafted a verdant tuberose in extrait form which is an olfactory embrace designed to uplift and transport you to moments of pure happiness. A scent to illuminate even the most uncertain days, evoking joy and serenity with every breath. .

Serene Silk Connections. The fragrance NIRAL (unique, calm, serene) is a perfume inspired by an interesting and unique relationship between British sericulture expert, author, printing-dyeing industrialist Sir Thomas Wardle (1831-1909) and India, celebrating his immense contribution to the promotion of Indian wild silk trade from Bengal and Kashmir to Europe.. Wardle’s contribution may have been forgotten but he influenced and collaborated with several great textile artists and silk printers of his generation such as William Morris (1834-1896), Léon-Victor Solon (1873-1957) and a number of influential artists from the Arts and Crafts movement.. Wardle perfected the technique for natural dyeing of the textured “tussar” silk, achieving stunning jewel toned colours reflected in our new box. His wife, Lady Elizabeth Wardle, founded the Leek Embroidery Society working on artistic needlework projects with tussar silk.. NIRAL, through its blend of rich raw materials is an ode to this quietly forceful silk ambassador. The perfume opens with iris, tea and liqueur notes weaving an intricate pattern with floral notes and spices akin to the textural delight of a piece of tussar silk, and symbolising a unique relationship between two countries linked by a common heritage..

An Olfactory Travelogue. Rahele (traveller) is the newest fragrance, an ode to exotic travel, an olfactory journey in the company of 17th Century French visitors to the East. It is truly an East meets West composition, centred around Osmanthus - melding the woods and spices of India with herbal and floral essences of classical French perfumery. Like the fabled French Blue, Rahele mesmerizes. Its sparkling facets reveal a delightful journey... Rahele is a travelogue of a fragrance - a journey to a longed-for destination. It is for those filled with curiosity about travel, art, beauty, cultures and a life without borders. Tavernier...Bernier...Thévenot...the names still resonate in the imagination of armchair travellers today, as each man left a detailed record of his adventures, showing us Mughal-ruled India through a European lens. Jean-Baptiste Tavernier (1605-1689) was a French jeweller of Belgian descent, an independently wealthy gem merchant who funded his own travels to the East, particularly to India. His book Les six voyages is still considered an important point of reference by historians. His trade in precious stones and pearls took him to the court during the construction of the Taj Mahal. On one of his voyages, Tavernier bought a gigantic blue diamond in Golconda which he subsequently sold to the Sun King, Louis XIV. The Tavernier diamond, or French Blue as it came to be called, was a centrepiece in the French crown jewels. According to legend, the precious stone was stolen during the French Revolution, only to turn up many years later in London, recut as the Hope diamond.. Francois Bernier (1620–1688) was physician to the eldest son of Shah Jahan and, more widely, to the court during his 12-year stay in India. He saw various rulers, was an astute social observer and contributed greatly to the understanding of court life and life in India generally through his book Travels in the Mughal Empire, AD 1656-1668.. The third traveller, Jean Thévenot (1633-1667), was a linguist and botanist. The travels of Monsieur Thévenot into the Levant describes in detail his observations during his travels. This book was the first part of his Voyages and was published while he was alive. The other two parts of Thévenot’s Voyages were published posthumously.. Tavernier and Thévenot actually met in India for a brief period, and Bernier and Tavernier’s paths crossed as well. All three travellers were some of the best social historians of their times who witnessed court life and splendours first-hand and wrote about their insights into the mystique of India..

Majestic Reflections . Lake Pichola is the crown jewel and central focus of the princely city of Udaipur.. A myriad of colourful historic, architectural and spiritual reflections fall on this splendid water body - the sunlight and moonlight of each season bringing out the eternal and timeless beauty of Lake Pichola.. Pichola captures such countless reflections on the lake from the past to the present - showcasing the splendour of opulent and vibrant flowers, princely spices and precious woods taking us on an unforgettable and hypnotic fragrant journey. Once you have experienced the diverse and stunning beauty of these indescribable reflections you will understand the true meaning of timeless luxury and effortless beauty.... . Top notes : Cardamom, cinnamon, saffron, juniper, magnolia, neroli oil, clementine, bergamot . Heart notes : Orange blossom absolute, rose absolute, tuberose absolute, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang . Base notes : Benzoin absolute, sandalwood, driftwood, vetiver from Haiti.

Imperialist Buddhist. Inspired by a legendary ruler, Ashoka is a tribute to an emperor who was conquered by his own compassion at the moment his victory was assured.. He converted to Buddhism and devoted the rest of his life to spreading the Buddha’s teachings, to truth, to justice and to compassion for all living creatures beneath the sun.. His own evolution from ruthless conqueror to benevolent emperor is reflected in Ashoka’s journey from the fierce opening to a softly floral heart & the gentle embrace of its richly complex dry-down.. . Top notes : Lotus, rose, water hyacinth, fig leaf, parsley leaf . Heart notes : Osmanthus absolute, cassie absolute (acacia farnesiana), iris, incense essence, jasmine sambac, fig milk, geranium, ylang-ylang . Base notes : Fir balsam absolute, myrrh, cedarwood, sandalwood, vanilla accord, ambre gris, birch, Haitian vetiver, leather, styrax, heliotrope.

Contemporary India . This joyful creation embodies every aspect of the very modern, colourful, eclectic, esoteric, ecstatic, liberal, happy side of buzzing India, a world economic power, where nothing is to be taken for granted, where the underbelly of the big city combines with the glitter of Bollywood on the vast sandy stretches of Juhu Beach and the Queen’s Necklace.. Fortunes are made and lost on the Bombay stock exchange and gambling dens of Mumbai.. Abandon yourself to the nightlife as dawn breaks over the city.. There is nothing like it and there will be nothing like it.. Welcome to a vibrant new India!. . Top notes : Mango, lychee, blackcurrant, cardamom, cumin Heart notes : Turkish rose, jasmine sambac absolute, Madagascar ylang-ylang, tuberose, frangipani, gardenia Base notes : Patchouli, tobacco, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla .

Mughal-British Raj Era. Mohur is a rose-based fragrance, a combination of opulent Moghul rose perfumes and a distinguished spicy leather bouquet that can only be imagined during a polo match. To capture this moment, Mohur has been created as a refined rose-oudh alliance that pays tribute to Noor Jahan’s power and talent. Empress Noor Jahan devoted herself to the art of perfumery as it had been passed down from her mother. It exemplifies the nearly 500-year span of India’s history that was shaped by a succession of influences from the outside world, from invaders to traders to colonizers, and which also gave rise to some of the most magnificent architecture the world has ever seen, including the Taj Mahal. The word Mohur derives from Sanskrit and refers to the most valuable gold coin in India’s history, the last of which were minted in 1918. The scent embodies, and is a dedication to, the mix of all the best of Moghul and the British Raj - a complex period in history for Indians which saw the flowering of unique gifts of the arts, music and education.. . Top notes : Cardamom absolute, coriander seed oil, ambrette seed, carrot, black pepper, elemi oil Heart notes : Turkish rose oil, Morrocan rose absolute, jasmine, orris, hawthorn, almond milk, violet, orris, leather Base notes : Sandalwood, patchouli, oudh palao oil from Laos, benzoin, vanilla, tonka bean .

Vedic Era. The Vedic tradition suggests that wisdom is eternal. It exists within the eternal fabric of consciousness itself and is uncreated. It is the essence of India, the beginning of the journey. It is a eulogy, a hymn to the idea of India, an act of deepest reverence for the traditions of the mother country. The divine origin of the first three Vedas - Rig, Yajur and Sama - suggested the name of the perfume: Trayee (pronounced ‘try-ee’, meaning ‘the triad’). Trayee is a complex fragrance that represents the boundless spiritual landscape of the great Vedic period, which started many centuries ago: its intricate rituals and temple ceremonies, ayurveda, the universe of yoga and the holistic quest for knowledge. The perfume itself has a high percentage of natural ingredients used in many of the Vedic ceremonies.. . Top notes : Blue ginger from Madagascar, elemi oil, cinnamon bark, ganja effects, blackcurrant absolute, basil Heart notes : Sambac jasmine absolute, Egyptian jasmine absolute, cardamom absolute, clove, saffron, sandalwood Base notes : Javanese vetiver, Haitian vetiver, incense, sandalwood oil, patchouli, myrrh, vanilla, cedar, amber notes, oudh from Laos, oak moss .

listings.rawTitle: Artist Collection Sample Set 3 x 1.5ml Extrait
listings.description: The Artist Collection from Thomas de Monaco: Flowers for Future is a vision of a new garden, where molecules grow what nature has not yet imagined. No nostalgia – only reinvention. . Three perfumers of tomorrow have shaped this collection: raw, surprising, alive. A contemporary approach to niche, written in the poetry of expectation..

Ugo Charron approached this project with rare intensity – sharp, visionary, almost electric. The idea of silver surfaced early and never left us. It became the structure around which Fleur Danger was built – a flower that pierces rather than blooms.. Wrapped in metal and tension, it protects the soft beauty within. Ugo shaped a scent full of friction and grace, anchored by a unique steel accord.. Fleur Danger is not decorative. It is defiant..

David Chieze once told Thomas de Monaco about a flower he had seen during his studies in Lyon – the Liane de Jade. Striking in form, hypnotic in colour, but without a scent. That absence stayed with him.. Years later, he returned to it with a question: what would this flower smell like if nature had completed it?. Jade Amour is his answer – a fragrance imagined from silence, shaped with emotion and precision. Intimate and luminous, it brings presence to something that never had one..

listings.rawTitle: Portrait of a Lady Hair Mist 50ml
listings.description: PORTRAIT OF A LADY hair mist by Dominique Ropion. An extravagant rose, full of voluptuousness and opulence. A mist to be sprayed onto the hair, enveloping it in a halo of delicate scent that will be refreshed every time you move your head, all day long. A perpetually sensual way to use perfume. PORTRAIT OF A LADY exalts the opulence and voluptuousness of the Turkish rose, in extravagant proportions. With this creation, Frédéric Malle and perfumer Dominique Ropion mark a new era in the great timeline of perfumery. With this extravagant rose, amplified with woody tones, amber and frankincense, the designers are redefining the boundaries of the Chypre (Cypress) olfactory family, synonymous with the finest eras of 20th-century perfumery. Their play of light and shade, their elegance and extreme refinement. This expert craftsmanship brings forth a splendour created to defy the test of time. . Top Notes: Rose Heart Notes: Blackcurrant, Raspberry, Clove Base Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Frankincense .

Like the memory of a refuge of a child's treehouse, the reassuring notes of wax, honey, and incense mixed with woody notes of sandalwood and guaiac make this a comforting candle. The chic signature of a peaceful evening. . An address. A cocoon. A retreat on the edge of the city. A candle as a tribute. A scent as a gift, offering comfort with its soothing notes of worn furniture; like a countryside home. It’s the crackle of autumn. Polished wood warms the heart. A vague memory of a luthier’s workshop. Honeyed tranquillity and serenity. The voluptuousness of noble woods and resins, sandalwood, guaiac, incense. A sacred scent of childhood to which one returns for comfort. A flame of solace. A miracle of generosity. The fluffy softness of a refuge to carry with you. .

A candle is a way of daily living a smell: entering a room, closing eyes and slowly inhaling it for the pleasure of it. With this N°6 candle, referencing Maison Marc-Antoine Barrois (6 rue de Budapest in Paris), Marc-Antoine Barrois has wished to fill his Maison de Couture with the olfactory memories of his childhood: Memories of a large house where the elegance of his grandfather prevailed in the leather scent of a precious attaché-case. The warm atmosphere of an afternoon spent with his family in the living room beside the fireplace, with some delicate scents occasionally floating out of the kitchen where an afternoon snack was being prepared. . Perfumer Quentin Bisch has immersed himself in the universe of the couturier once more: working around the same leathery , woody and spicy frame, adding amber scents and smoothing it with smoky notes to create a scented candle which expresses his taste for refined materials. This candle has a generous complexity of woven leather warming up to the heat of balms, a signature where patchouli takes on the sensual refinery of amber to enhance the muted appeal of Marc-Antoine Barrois' boutique. A leathery atmosphere, that is at the same time thick and enveloping, and made even by the golden lights of cistus-labdanum. A comfortable scent, that is shimmering and twisted with the spicy notes of cumin and saffron. There is also a fruity hint, tasting like peach and plum which lights up the harmony of amber and wood in which sandalwood and patchouli notes unite.. Made in France and comprised of 60% natural and 40% mineral wax to produce the optimum burn and scent throw and reduces soot emissions..

Created by Dominique Ropion for the Desert Gems collection, HOPE fragrance exalts the nobility of an exceptional oud essence. . They say that it’s the pillar of the world. Others whisper about it giving life. Hope has always been right there at the heart of humanity. The third masterpiece by Dominique Ropion for the Desert Gems collection, HOPE is an amber and woody fragrance that highlights the absolute nobility of an exceptional oud essence. The smoky, leathery notes of incense and vetiver mingle with the spicy freshness of pink peppercorn, cypress and juniper to reveal oud in all its purity. A scent of unparalleled elegance. . Top Notes: Pink pepper, Cypress, Juniper oil Heart Notes: Oud oil, Vetiver Base Notes: Amber, Leather, Incense .

Celestial Romance.. The moon plays a leading role in conducting the rhythm of life in the Middle East, her ethereal appearance hailing the beginning and end of all festivity. Yet in Arabic, invoking the moon is also an allusion to romance — ‘my moon’; an adoringly grandiose term for one’s beloved that speaks of beauty and eternal devotion.. Exuding a warm, opulent quality, rose, oud and frankincense meet a surprising abundance of ripe red berries. In subtle evocation of the fruit-flavoured shisha enjoyed across the region, the profusion of redcurrant and raspberry notes adds sweetness and colour.. A potent new moon..

A unisex Floral, Amber, Extrait de Parfum imagined as a burning desire by perfumer Jordi Fernandez for D'ORSAY. . A burst of Bergamot and Peach fans the flames of temptation. An opulent, insolent Rose, edged with Iris, unveils its voluptuously fatal petals beneath the swirls of burning Sandalwood. On the skin, Benzoin and Vanilla settle in - velvety, intoxicating. Amber warms, whispers to instinct, stokes a heart already racing with spice.. Rose Blaze is built around duos of Rose, Iris, and Tonka, confronting and harmonising to create a fragrance unlike any other..

An explosion of red berries, juicy and radiant strawberry, opens like a well-kept secret under a milky veil. Iris lends it its mystery, White oud leaves a sacred trail on the skin, while sandalwood wraps the moment in a warm breath. Vanilla envelopes it all in a dark and disrupting caress..

Un Air d'Apogée now rises as a perfume extrait, with a concentration of 30%.. The leathery nuances of its signature deepen, amplified by a tactile, almost tangible texture. An unexpected note of raspberry emerges, cutting through the composition like a glimmer in the darkness. Juicy, vibrant, it illuminates the leather, creating a delicious tension between strength and sweetness.. Iris, the house's cornerstone, maintains balance. Its powdery softness links the extremes without smoothing them, adding a delicate subtlety to this vibrant contrast.. On the skin, the leather becomes a dark, raw caress, alive yet entirely free of animal-derived ingredients. Vegan, it retains all its nobility without compromise.. Un Air d'Apogée Extrait: richer, darker, more intense. A fragrance of embraced contrasts, where leather and raspberry intertwine in a profound, intoxicating sensuality..

Perfume often comes with endless stories, sometimes too many. We chose to smile at this reality and give a simple and honest answer to one of the most frequent questions: “I’m looking for vanilla perfumes.” A clear way to express a taste without technical vocabulary.. A lab sample left on a desk, discovered by chance… and from that spark, Looking for Vanilla / 43 was born.. Starting with Indian Jasmine and a hint of Orange Accord, it brings an immediate and sunny brightness that is effortless to enjoy. The heart reveals a bold combination of Bitter Almond, Tonka Bean and Cherry that offer a deep, sweet, yet confident gourmand impact. Finally, the base composed of Vanilla and a special Patchouli provide power, warmth and depth.. Immediate, intense and long-lasting, Looking for Vanilla is a pure unisex fragrance that instantly captivates the nose from the very first spray. Probably the fragrance with the most powerful sillage in the Parle Moi de Parfum collection.. While Flavia Vanilla is a bit more feminine and Comète Paradis is a woody with gourmand tones, Looking for Vanilla is the vanilla everyone has been waiting for..

Noble Myrrh takes its name from the legendary resin that was caravanned on epic journeys across the ancient incense route from Ethiopia, Somalia, and southern Arabia to the Ancient Empires. According to Christmas tradition, the magus Balthazar travelled on this route too. Guided by a bright star, the Arabian King carried Myrrh to Bethlehem on Christmas Day.. In Noble Myrrh, the intensely warm and comforting Myrrh is artfully blended with a crackle of spicy cinnamon and cumin. Delicate threads of saffron are woven through a billowing oriental base of sandalwood, cedar leaf, patchouli, labdanum and vanilla.. The candle weighs 280g with a burn time of 55-60 hours.. Please note that Cloon Keen candles are not eligible for gift wrapping. .

Noble Fir is the unique and enchanting tinglingly-thrilling scent of Christmas and the Mid-Winter Solstice: green, earthy and honeyed.. Fir also yields a magnificently powerful healing oil to warm the blood, boost energy levels and lift the spirits. For centuries it was an essential medicine of wizards, wise women and shamans. The fir tree was venerated as the tutelary Spirit of the Forest, a link between Earth and Heaven, a sustainer of life, fertility and a source of cosmic energies.. Candle weighs 280g with a burn time of 55-60 hours.. Please note that Cloon Keen candles are not eligible for gift wrapping. .

As it often does, James Heeley's creative process began with one single ingredient - the rich, complex notes of labdanum concrete: smoky wood, amber, honey, and dates take us back to Phoenicia (1200 BC).. The Phoenicians were one of the first European civilisations to harvest dates, grapes, and produce wine. They were also supreme navigators of the Levantine (eastern and southern Mediterranean). Highly skilled craftsmen and traders of precious metals, textiles, leather, and exotic woods. They invented Tyrian purple - a rare pigment made from crushed seashells, subsequently used to dye the cloaks of Emperors.. . Top Notes: Incense. Heart Notes: Labdanum, Dates, Honey. Base Notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood, Leather, Amber.

Aromatic, woody, leathery. A composition with depth and edge.. With Black Oregano, Atelier Materi reimagines the aromatic intensity through a striking composition built around oregano, a rare and unexpected raw material that unveils it's wild richness and elusive depth.. From the very first notes, a sharp burst of lime, cardamom, and rosemary strikes with dazzling freshness.. At the heart the warmth rises. Oregano unfolds its aromatic facets, wrapped in the creamy texture of Australian sandalwood and the smoky elegance of vetiver, adding depth and tension. . As it settles, the fragrance deepens. The trail turns darker, denser. Indonesian patchouli, cistus labdanum, and oud wood ground the blend in a woody, leathery sensuality.. Black Oregano is the unexpected encounter of cool and warm, of bright aromatics and enveloping woods. A striking, contrasting composition that reveals the ambivalent beauty of raw material.. An intense, nuanced Extrait de Parfum that reflects the Maison's ethos: exploring raw materials differently..

Inspired by the city of Paris, KILIAN PARIS presents Fièvre Verte, a hymn to a legendary Parisian-liquor: absinthe. The perfume expresses the traditional French ‘Happy Hour', that early evening window of time when absinthe was served upon sugar into a glass and swirled with a spoon in a slow-paced ritual in which the liquid turns pastel green. This hue reappears in Fièvre Verte, an entirely naturally derived color: tender like a Parisian haze, or a Van Gogh painting coming to life. . Absinthe essence opens Fièvre Verte with an instant head twist into a nostalgic heart of violet leaf and licorice root absolute. Its dry-down articulates a unique and precisely chosen facet of patchouli that resonates throughout, and blends into a trio of earthy woods along with vetiver and sandalwood. Fièvre Verte expresses Paris at its best - indulgent and life-changing in its luxuries and wonderful illusions. . Perfumer: Mathieu Nardin. Top Notes: Absinthe Heart Notes: Violet Leaf Base Notes: Patchouli .

listings.rawTitle: L'Air du Désert Marocain Noir 50ml Elixir
listings.description: 'There are moments in life when scent becomes memory, and memory becomes a place. Twenty years ago, I created L’Air du Désert Marocain, inspired by a memory that stayed with me: lying on a narrow bed in a simple Moroccan hotel room, the window open to the warm evening air. The life of the city drifted in with spices from the souk, smoke from distant fires, the sweetness of pastries, and above all, the breath of the desert, dry, warm, infinite. That moment became a perfume. . After many years, I revisited L'Air du Désert Marocain again. As a perfumer, I have created many fragrances, but I have always had a soft spot for L'Air du Désert Marocain. Over the years, I often thought about my desert perfume, and the night in the desert was one of many lines of thought. How the landscape changes when the sun disappears. How shadows take the place of mirages, how the air sharpens, how everything becomes more silent, more profound. And this, I wanted to encapsulate in a new fragrance. . L'Air du Désert Marocain Noir is not a reinterpretation of the original, but a continuation, a deeper and darker step into the same story. I wanted to create a perfume that captures the experience of walking into the desert at night. When the sun is gone, but the stones and boulders still radiate the heat of the day. The horizon is black and empty and there are no mountains, no trees, just a line where sand kisses sky. It is a sinister, peaceful environment, dark and deep. . I imagined this elixir as the scent of a walk into this desert at night. . I imagined the warmth of the night. Besides many smaller changes, at the heart of L' Air du Désert Marocain Noir I have intensified the cistus and the resinous warmth. The amber is drier, more expansive, vast like the night. The perfume is richer, deeper, with strength and with 30% concentration this elixir feels unending. . And then, there are the stars. I imagined their cold, distant, blinking shine. I added more sparkling citrus notes to the perfume formula of L' Air du Désert Marocain Noir , from bergamot to lemon to petitgrain , to evoke their shimmer, a sharp brilliance that contrasts the depth of the fragrance and adds a fresh airiness. . When I created this elixir, I wanted to capture that feeling: experiencing a desert night that is simply beautiful. . Air du Désert Marocain Noir is my invitation to perfume lovers: To walk further into the night'. .

In 1912, the French perfumer Robert Bienaimé unveiled his Quelques Fleurs as a ground-breaking multi-floral masterpiece, the first of its kind. . Since then, his perfectly-balanced, refined bouquet has become modern perfumery’s peerless criterion for pure, meticulously-crafted, multi-floral accords. Upwards of 15,000 exemplary flowers and 250 prestigious raw materials are diligently-curated in the creation of a single ounce of Quelques Fleurs. . The alluring fragrance is still composed in Grasse, France, overlooking the same historic landscapes that had inspired its formulation over 100 years ago. .

Hidden behind an unassuming colonial façade lies this modernist oasis, where glass and travertine surfaces frame a garden brimming with life: palm trees, bird of paradise flowers, leafy ginger plants bordering the pool. Beneath the tree, a weathered Mayan idol lies half-buried, silently whispering the ancient stories woven into the everyday of this vibrant city. .

Evocative of a breezy tropical evening, this luxurious woody and sweet parfum d’interieur is inspired by reveries in the magical island of Bali. . Opening with sweet notes of patchouli, vanilla and coconut, balanced by a hint of Lily of the Valley and warm woody undertones. .

This beautifully understated and elegant Parfum D'Interior captures the essence of nostalgia and memories in Singapore. . Opening with the tropical notes of coconut and bergamot, the fragrance is delicately balanced by a hint of green tea and soft florals, and warm ambery musk undertones. . Created in memory of warm afternoons in Singapore, the fragrance is inspired by both the lushness and simplicity of the beautiful country; a balance of yin and yang. .

"A breakfast in the garden on the French Riviera, a sip of sunshine. Just the right amount of light, freshness and energy. Sunny Spring outside, an April morning when the softness still remains." - Michel Almairac . Orange Hyper Essence / X, the new citrus note from Parle Moi de Parfum, reveals a tonic brightness where the core essence of Orange blends with fine bubbles and a hint of spices. . The heart of two exceptional varieties: Oranges from Valencia under the Spanish sun and Oranges from the Californian valleys come together, blending with a slightly spicy note of Ginger. A luminous intensity, perfectly balanced between zestful glow and the juicy sweetness of the fruit, capturing the purest essences of Orange. An orange like you have never experienced before.. Cardamom, a solar and woody spice, adds a soft and warm richness, while fine bubbles inspired by a Prosecco accord mix the composition with a light and refreshing sparkle. . Orange Hyper Essence / X appeals to those who enjoy bold, fresh and balanced fragrances. This scent will captivate admirers of Tomboy Neroli, Wake Up World or Haute Provence who appreciate sophisticated fragrances..

Made exclusively for Les Senteurs by Memoirs of a Perfume Collector, Belgravia Iris is a beautiful rendition of a modern iris fragrance.. Belgravia Iris is a captivating perfume inspired by the elegance and charm of London's prestigious Belgravia neighbourhood. This fragrance embodies the essence of luxury and sophistication, reflecting the area’s exquisite architecture and lush gardens. Belgravia Iris opens with vibrant notes of orange and bergamot, complemented by a hint of spicy ginger, evoking a fresh and invigorating atmosphere. The heart is a floral bouquet featuring iris and violet, symbolising beauty and grace, while a base of moss, cedar, incense, and musk adds depth and warmth, creating a harmonious blend that lingers on the skin. Perfect for those who appreciate refinement and quality, Belgravia Iris encapsulates the spirit of its enchanting surroundings.. Top Notes: Mandarin, Lemon, Bergamot, Ginger, Neroli, Orange. Heart Notes: Iris, Violet, Patchouli, Mastic, Galbanum. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Vetiver, Moss, Cedar, Incense, Benzoin, Musk, Sclarene.

Alone, sprawled in his car with the seat reclined, he listens to the murmur of the waves, his gaze lost in the wild expanse of the Atlantic. The biting winter cold seeps through the fogged-up windows, while the briny scent of seafoam still clings to his wetsuit, a fleeting echo of the waves he conquered the day before. Yet, another fragrance lingers in the air: the sharp, herbal freshness of a lavender sachet, once tucked into his clean wetsuit, now piercing the icy stillness with a revitalizing breath. . Inspired by Paul’s adventures along the untamed coast of Quiberon, this fragrance embodies the raw vitality of the Breton shoreline. The iodine-laden sea breeze merges with the soft, powdery notes of iris, conjuring the striking contrast between the rugged force of nature and the peaceful serenity of returning to land. A fragrance of contrasts, where invigorating freshness intertwines with a soothing warmth, like the crisp shiver of a winter morning before immersing yourself in the vastness of the waves. . . Top Notes: Lavandin, Mandarin, Mint, Pepper, Cardamom . Heart Notes: Violet leaf, Marine notes . Base Notes: Sandalwood, Iris .

On a winter morning, with the house still wrapped in slumber, the air is thick with a soft, cotton-like warmth. Outside, the biting cold has cast a frozen hush over the landscape, veiling it in pristine white. Inside, a gentle light filters through, caressing the still-warm sheets. It’s that suspended moment between dreams and awakening, when you nestle into the tender embrace of the morning. . Musc Angélique captures the sensation of absolute calm, between the purity of fresh linen and the comforting softness of skin still warmed by sleep. The musky notes, airy and enveloping, intertwine with the delicately powdered and soothing facets of angelica, creating a trail that is both ethereal and addictive. An invisible embrace, intimate and infinitely reassuring. Originally released as CYCLE 001 in 2020, this fragrance now makes a permanent return as part of the new collection Les Expressions . . . Top Notes: Pepper . Heart Notes: Iris, Angelica root . Base Notes: Vetiver, Incense, White musk .

A luminous burst of orange blossom, wrapped in the softness of delicate musks. California Blossom evokes the essence of a sun-drenched garden beneath California’s endless blue sky. Between lemon and orange trees, freshly laundered linens sway in the breeze, releasing their pure, effervescent fragrance. The air is crisp, golden with sunlight, and each breath captures the fleeting beauty of an endless summer. . This garden was Anthony’s grandmother’s, a sanctuary of memories where he spent every summer as a child. He recalls the vibrant scent of sun-kissed citrus and the delicate aroma of orange blossom-infused linens drying in the warm breeze. California Blossom is an olfactory madeleine, a luminous and embracing creation that distils the golden warmth of those cherished moments. A fragrance as pure and radiant as an endless summer’s day. . . Top Notes: Petitgrain, Sweet orange, Neroli . Heart Notes: Orange blossom, Iris, Ylang-ylang . Base Notes: White Musk .

Summer in a bottle. A luxurious reinterpretation of the Polynesian elixir Monoi Oil to indulge in summer’s scent and sensation all year long. Sunkissed Goddess opens with an opulent accord of creamy white Tiare flowers and sensual Ylang-Ylang essence. Embrace the legacy of Cleopatra VII, the legendary queen of Egypt whose unmatched allure captivated the world. Her secret ritual - immersing in rose-petal baths and savouring rose-infused tea sweetened with pure Nile honey - not only infused her with grace but also made her smell so enchanting, becoming a symbol of irresistible charm. Melos, named after the main actor in the scene and short for honey and rose tea - a metaphor for timeless charm. .

An intense, deep composition that unveils the leathery and spicy facets of Madagascan vanilla.. With Vanille Carbone, perfumer Natalie Gracia-Cetto explores the depth of a black vanilla pod, blending three exceptional qualities of Madagascan vanilla.. The fragrance unfolds with the vibrant spice of pink peppercorn and black pepper. At its heart, the smoky elegance of incense meets the luminous allure of a patent leather accord. In the base, vanilla unveils its warm, sensual, and delectable facets, leaving an irresistible trail.. A monochrome canvas of contrasting textures, between matte and shine, shadow and light, revealing the full intensity of black vanilla..

Kurky eau de parfum is a gourmand fragrance exploring a bouquet of nostalgic scents, reminiscent of tutti-frutti candies.. Kurky, the affectionate nickname of Francis Kurkdjian in his youth, evokes an insatiable desire for freedom. A musky fruity perfume with sweet notes that encourages you to see life in colour, to dream and be amazed again.. In a creamy cloud of white musks with a subtle hint of vanilla, Kurky distils delightfully nostalgic notes, evoking a tangy tutti-frutti accord, as if plucked straight from a candy box. An unexpected fragrance whose trail resonates like a great burst of laughter, a smile, and a ray of sunshine: this candy fragrance is an invitation to awaken the child within us.. Enough wonder to dream, enough recklessness to realise them: Kurky is the sweet fruity fragrance for those who dare to dream like the young at heart. This creamy fragrance wraps you in a comforting embrace of velvety white musk.. Olfactory family: gourmand musky fruity Olfactory notes: tangy fruity accord with tutti-frutti notes, gourmand musky accord with white musk and vanilla.

BIRTH OF A STAR A white light in the darkness. A mysterious clarity radiating from a nocturnal clearing. The caress of the moon on a field of tuberoses, immaculate petals reflecting the star's glow like a mirror. ALDEBARAN is a star, one of the brightest in the sky. It's the second star in the floral constellation imagined by designer Marc-Antoine Barrois and Master perfumer Quentin Bisch. Both protective and haughty, the diva of white flowers spreads her powerful halo of fragrance. A simplicity that gives the composition its dazzling modernity..

Blossoms Smoke / 57 embodies the evolution of the family legacy, with Romain Almairac carrying on the tradition of his father, Michel, while adding his own creative and personal touch.. The fragrance opens with smoky, intense, and earthy notes, creating an immediate impact. This smoky signature quickly fades, revealing white flowers that bring a luminous softness, with a burning, dangerous undertone, giving the fragrance a complex, evolving character. The contrast between strength and softness is an elegant balance of light and shadow.. Over time, the base reveals warm, ambery notes of Tonka Bean and Vanilla, creating a rich oriental atmosphere with a remarkably powerful sillage.. The deep midnight blue bottle reflects the spirit of other iconic creations of the house, such as Wake Up World (2022) and Comète Paradis (2023), while preserving the precious raw materials it contains.. A mixed fragrance with a more masculine edge, Blossoms Smoke / 57 particularly appeals to lovers of Papyrus Oud, Woody Perfecto and Cedar Woodpecker..

To woo is to captivate, to charm, to draw someone closer with an irresistible allure. It’s about creating a connection, and offering a glimpse of your soul that makes the other person linger just a little longer. We woo because it’s in our nature to desire closeness, to spark intrigue, to awaken passion. . Woo(e)d by ALTAIA captures this desire with an enchanting composition of notes: the warmth of Atlas cedarwood and the smoky elegance of Guaiac wood create a rich, grounding base. Layers of supple leather and the spicy sweetness of cardamom add an intriguing edge, while cistus brings a resinous, amber-like depth that leaves a trail of wonder and longing in your wake.. To woo, or to be woo(e)d. .

Sometimes, we dream of escaping — even briefly — to explore a world where anything is possible. These moments become an interlude, a source of comfort and serenity.. When we speak of Cocoa Butter, Tonka Bean or Vanilla, you can almost sense their aromas.. Add a creamy touch of Sandalwood and Musk, a subtle tribute to Parle Moi de Parfum's iconic Milky Musk, and you get Comète Paradis.. A sensory delight, an exquisite indulgence, a reality tinged with daydreams, an invitation to journey beyond the everyday..

Experience Eladaria, a dreamlike floral perfume from The House of Creed that reimagines the classic rose.. The fragrance awakens with sun-kissed mandarin warmed by pink pepper, inspired by a garden stirring to life in the silvery mist of dawn. A trio of rose soon blossoms at its heart intertwining with lily of the valley and peony to create a lush, romantic bouquet. These exquisite blooms then yield to an alluring base of cashmere wood, vanilla and musk, surrounding the wearer with sumptuous softness and sensuality. .

“L Red Tea Vetiver” by Clive Christian captures the rare essence of Rooibos, combining it with deeply aromatic woods and spices to evoke a sense of timeless adventure. This fragrance is not merely a scent, it is an experience, a journey through tradition and terroir, connecting luxury with the elemental power of the earth.. In this perfume, Rooibos Tea is elevated as the star note, celebrated for its smooth, almost honeyed warmth, which breathes an earthy vibrancy into each spray. This exquisite ingredient is harmonised with Vetiver, imparting a grounding, smoky depth that resonates like whispers of ancient African soils, intertwined with hints of spice, subtly transforming on the skin over time.. The perfume is encased in Clive Christian’s iconic bottle, adorned with a regal crown cap, a symbol of British heritage that mirrors the sophisticated blend within. Its rich, amber-toned glass reflects the warmth of the red tea, embodying both luxury and the raw beauty of nature..

Figuier Noir is a spicy, woody and fruity fragrance by perfumer Celine Ellena that gained its inspiration during lockdown whilst she was sitting in the countryside in the shade of a black fig tree. . Celine formulated a brief series of ingredients used to define men, creating the perfect men’s fragrance, reassuring and elegant. . A synergy of saps to reach the unattainable star, a combination of woods to emphasize sincerity, an interlacing of roots to anchor the signature and a trail of exquisite spices and black fig pulp, because beyond the bitterness of the sap and the roughness of the wood, is the heart of the man. .

71 Elizabeth Street - A Story of Heritage and Passion. For Saeed Alnuaimi, founder of The Scent Library, London has always been more than just a destination - it's where cherished memories were made.. As a boy of only ten years old, Saeed would travel to London with his father. One of their most treasured traditions was spending peaceful afternoons in Hyde Park, enjoying lemon drizzle cake and coffee on the same bench each time. This ritual became so meaningful that Saeed now continues it with his own son, sitting on that same bench, reliving those sweet moments with every bite and sip.. . Top Notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Saffron, Cardamom, Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Tobacco, Oud (Agarwood), Jasmine, Geranium, Lily of the valley, Cedarwood. Base Notes: Leather, Musk, Tonka bean, Benzoin, Tolu.
