Fresh and spicy, this new opus brings together the strength of amber woods concentrated in notes of Ambrocénide Crystal (Ambroxan) along with refreshing notes of mandarin, bergamot and ginger.. Uncompromising, bold, filled with enigmatic charm. Based on master perfumer Maurice Roucel’s personal cologne, Uncut Gem is an unapologetically manly scent, diamond-hard and absolutely fresh. Clear, spicy top notes of ginger, bergamot, mandarin, angelica root and nutmeg lead you to the sensual fire within: a leathery accord, vetiver, frankincense, generous amounts of amber, and a musk that vibrates with the skin. This is a scent that plays with the tired codes of masculinity while extracting their telluric force to create something beautiful and irresistible. . Top Notes: Ginger, Bergamot, Mandarin, Angelica Root, Nutmeg Heart Notes: Frankincense, Vetiver, Cistus Labdanum Base Notes: Amber, Musk .

listings.rawTitle: Atman Xaman Moisturising Beard & Aftershave Balm 100ml
listings.description: A deep, intense, mysterious fragrance that radiates unique atmospheres: magical, spiritual, real and imaginary.. An enveloping scent of Leather, Tobacco and precious woods with light undertones of flowers and wild herbs, on a gentle, sensual background of fragrant resins, of Vanilla and Patchouli, of Amber and Musk.. Moisturising balm without alcohol, to be used for beard grooming or as an aftershave, to soothe and soften the skin.. Try the Atman Xaman Eau de Parfum ..

Founder Kilian Hennessy had been developing his own cologne for years, sparked by a desire to return to the roots and meaning of this unique genre of perfume. The result, a unique interpretation of Cologne which takes you on an incredible sensory trip across freshness, intensity and time.. Kologne takes a classic out to party. With luminous citrus notes throughout, Kologne is a splash of freshness. The fragrance debuts with refreshing notes of green mandarin, bitter orange and mint leading into a heart of rosemary and neroli. A woody drydown is built around cedarwood, cashmeran and and a unique “sap” accord of green vegetal notes. Created as a shield of protection, it is a fragrance to spray around oneself like an aura of purity and vitality.. Top Notes: Green Mandarin, Bitter Orange, Mint Heart Notes: Rosemary, Neroli Base Notes: Cedarwood, Cashmeran, Vegetal Sap Accord .

Working the ingredient to express its full potential and meeting the challenge of composing two different eaux de parfum with the same notes: juniper berries, nutmeg, coriander, musks, ambery woods and vanilla. The Gentle Fluidity duo was born of the perfumer’s imagination to offer two distinct olfactory silhouettes, for her or for him.. In Gentle Fluidity Gold's generous, enveloping trail, we can find coriander seed essence and an overdose of musks and vanilla. The floral, spicy note of coriander seeds brings, just like musks, ethereal volume and a lingering trail. In the base notes, the gourmand, reassuring notes of the vanilla accord enhanced by the ambery woods reveal a radiant, bright silhouette.. Top Notes: Nutmeg, Coriander Heart Notes: Juniper Berry, Amber .

Shopping for a friend but unsure what fragrance to give them? Give them the gift of choice with a Les Senteurs gift card. E-Gift cards are delivered by email with no additional processing fees. Once you receive your E-Gift cards in your inbox, forward it to your loved one.. E-Gift Cards are valid both in-store and online. Valid for 2 years from the date of purchase. . How to Redeem Your Les Senteurs E-Gift Card . Shop the website adding your desired product to your bag.. Continue through checkout as normal. At the point of payment enter the code found on your E-Gift Card email in the Gift Card payment box.. If the value of your order is more than the value of your E-Gift Card you will be required to pay the remaining balance with a credit or debit card or by using PayPal. Enter your payment details and click ‘Complete order’.. If the value of your order is less than the value of your E-Gift Card you will be able to complete your order by clicking ‘Complete order’.. No physical card is sent via post, electronic delivery only..

'The lovely flower'. Say it “pool nana”.. A fantastic aromatic fougere . A fresh, sweet floral composition on a soft, warm, woody base.. Originally created in 1891, this scent is a rare marriage of the herb garden with the flower garden, unusual in a feminine fragrance. It paved the way for the ‘modern’ fragrances that were to follow. Phul-Nana is perhaps the most famous of the series: at the time of the Great War, the best-selling fragrance in the UK.. Top: Bergamot, Orange, Neroli Heart: Geranium, Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang Base: Patchouli, Cedar, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Opoponax, Vanilla .

Using the original formulae and keeping natural materials wherever possible, irrespective of cost, Grossmith have ‘remastered’ three classic fragrances, Hasu-no-Hana (1888), Phul-Nana (1891) and Shem-el-Nessim (1906).. Top Notes: Bergamot, Neroli Heart Notes: Geranium, Jasmine, Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Orris Root Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli, Cedar, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Heliotrope .

James Heeley’s signature scent: a perfume fit for a Prince of the Church – swathes of incense and patchouli but freshened by vetiver and bitter myrrh to suggest immaculate crisp white linen beneath the scarlet soutane. James Heeley's Vetiver Veritas is a unique perfume event. 100% natural and 72% organic, this is a deep, complex and revelatory vetiver with superb depth and sillage which uncovers notes of sweet dry grass, sun-fed earth, mint and grapefruit in one of perfumery's most ancient and legendary oils. Heeley uses over 90% of Haitian vetiver to create this darkest and most radical of fougeres. The organic alcohol in which the formula is suspended is of rye and lavender: the best-kept secret is the way in which the orthodox olfactory pyramid appears inverted, with the golden citrus notes appearing at the base rather than the top of this stupendous scent.. Top Notes: Lavender, Mint Heart Notes: Haitian Vetiver Base Notes: Grapefruit .

Candice Bergen was the direct inspiration for iconic tuberose Carnal Flower. Cologne Indelebile by Dominique Ropion illustrates its creator's belief that the simplest creations often generate the strongest and most powerful emotions.. This is a pure but opulent eau de cologne formula blending the finest neroli, orange zest, orange blossom, lemon and bergamot on the same deliciously musky bases that Ropion uses in Portrait of a Lady and Geranium Pour Monsieur .. A hint of heady narcissus absolute contributes to the perfume’s unusual freshness and adds a touch of white creamy florality. The musk accords create a sense of cleanliness and simultaneous animal sexuality leading to a perfume which is an ambiguous & compelling paradox.. Top Notes: Lemon and Bergamot Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Base Note: Musks .

Probably the most romantic perfume in the collection. The late Edmond Roudnitska designed this for his wife, Therese, in the 1960’s. It was originally for her sole use, and later considered too daring and unusual for the world stage. Now Frederic Malle offers it to you at Les Senteurs. The top notes contain melon, mandarin, jasmine and pepper, floating on a heart of plum blossoms, rose and nutmeg above a profound base of leather, vetiver and cedar. A rare and haunting chypre fragrance.. Top Notes: Mandarin, Melon, Jasmine, Pepper Heart Notes: Rose, Plum blossom, Nutmeg Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Leather .

Maurice Roucel recommends this elegantly indulgent oriental fragrance for both sexes.. Musc Ravageur is dark and dangerous; deceptively fresh top notes of lavender, bergamot and orange yield to sensual depths of cloves, gaiac wood, tonka, vanilla and cedar. A perfume of the night… ”Comme il est beau, mon gangster!” as Mistinguett used to sing.. That’s Musc Ravageur!. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Lavender Heart Notes: Amber, Vanilla, Musk Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk .

Portrait of a Lady is perhaps Dominique Ropion’s most sublime achievement – an overdose of the finest Turkish rose absolute ( 400 flowers per 100ml bottle) , blended with raspberry, cassis, clove, cinnamon, patchouli and amber. Simmering and stunning, profound sillage and mysterious alluring sexuality.. Consider perfume a portrait of its wearer: the sound of her voice, her gaze, the way she plays cards. At once timeless and resonant with today, here is a scent that speaks of her innate sophistication. Charm that emanates from within, boldly depicted without; an expressive portrayal of modern grace.. Top Notes: Rose Heart Notes: Blackcurrant, Raspberry, Clove Base Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Frankincense .

Dryad is a fragrance of imagination and wonder: a miracle of the trees and the woodlands. Sharp top accords of cedrat and thyme lead into fragrant harmonies of iris, lavender and deer tongue (a lily) melded with the heady floral tones of jonquil and narcissus. The gorgeous deep dark base is a rich composition of clary sage, costus, galbanum, iconic oakmoss, vetiver and benzoin.. Top Notes: Narcissus, Cedar, Thyme Heart Notes: Iris, Lavender, Deer's Tongue, Jonquil Base Notes: Sage, Galbanum, Oakmoss, Vetiver, Benzoin .

listings.rawTitle: L'Air Du Désert Marocain 50ml EDT Intense
listings.description: Andy's own favourite: memories of a night in Marrakesh; the sweet-smelling air of the Maghreb Desert. A soft, dusky harmony of rock rose, coriander and cumin – with just a hint of bitter orange and Moroccan jasmine. A luxurious lightly spicy base of dry cedar, vetiver and ambergris.. Top Notes: Coriander, Cumin, Petitgrain, Lavender Heart Notes: Jasmine, Labdanum, Birch, Geranium Base Notes: Ambergris Background, Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli, Oakmoss .

This is a vibrant perfume that is out of this world. Bursting with wonderous citrus and floral tones, this is a fragrance that exceeds all expectations. A gorgeous evocation of a Moroccan orange orchard, with dew still on the lemon grass carpeted with orange flowers.. The opening notes are a golden blaze of mandarin and clementine which yield to a sensuous base of dark vanilla, tonka bean and cedar wood. Adult, unusual, sophisticated.. . Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Clementine Heart Notes: Lemongrass, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Ambergris, Tonka Bean, Vanilla .

A fresh translucent modern rose accented with a beautiful accord of lychee which develops into soft cedarwood and musk. The perfume is inspired by the romantic story of Marina's grandmother, a great beauty who at the age of sixteen received her first proposal of marriage in the glorious rose gardens of Sudeley Castle, her ancestral home.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Litchi Heart Notes: Rose, Peony, Osmanthus Base Notes: Cedar, Musk .

A stopover in balmy Rio de Janeiro during an Atlantic crossing from Argentina to Europe. On the Corcovado mountain, an old car gently ascends a narrow road through a swirl of cobalt-blue butterflies, the sweet scent of tuberose wafting in through the open windows.. Top Notes: Mandarin, Neroli Heart Notes: Tuberose, Freesia, Heliotrope Base Notes: Cedar, Sandalwood .

An unusual and entrancing hesperidic of delicate citrus notes overlaid with green tea, orange blossom absolute and iris. Yu Son is named after an ancient Chinese poem of the same name, this beautiful scent draws its inspiration from the texture of orange flowers - symbols of love, purity and steadfastness. This fragrance is composed as an homage to Marina and Sebastian's great love and their first meeting in the south of Italy where vast groves of orange trees perfume the air.. Top Notes: Mandarin, Green Tea Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Iris Base Notes: Amber, Guaiac Wood .

Deceptively demure top notes of sambac jasmine and osmanthus are belied by the erotic heart of Indian tuberose, narcissus and the honeyed sweetness of rose de Mai on a golden base of cedar and amber.. The scent of a frosted moon in all its ethereal radiance. Delphine Thierry's creation is a wondrously soft and woody blend of angelica, orris, vetiver and galbanum; passionate, warm and earthy, but kissed by the cool fresh silvery powderiness of moonlight. Intimate and sensuous, Frosted Moon is an intriguingly paradoxical perfume.. Top Notes: Angelica Root and Seed Heart Notes: Ambrette Seed, Carrot Seed, Iris Root Base Notes: Galbanum, Vetiver, Cedar, Musk .

An exotic blend of incense and bergamot provides an unusual head accord before the fragrance swells like music into a full-blown heart of jasmine, Bulgarian rose and an aromatic billow of sandalwood. The complex base is semi-oriental with a combination of amber, spicy patchouli, musk and dry sweet cedar. A wonderfully ample perfume, with a powderiness and tranquillity which is irresistible. An ode to the art of perfecting oneself; a stylish sophisticated indulgence.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Rum Absolute Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, Patchouli Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Incense .

Evoking the legendary men whose inspiration and drive has changed the face of the world. Aventus conjures up lost empires, far distant lands and exotic ambitions.. Creed's Aventus pays homage to iconic leaders such as Alexander the Great and Napoleon Bonaparte whose achievements left a triumphant and vibrant legacy that is still felt today.. With luscious top notes of bergamot, blackcurrant, apple and pineapple; the smoky, floral heart is an intriguing blend of jasmine, birchwood, patchouli and juniper; with a virile, warm base of musk, oakmoss, vanilla and a liberal use of Creed's trademark ambergris.. Top Notes: Apple, Blackcurrant leaves, Pineapple, Bergamot Heart Notes: Juniper Berries, Birch, Patchouli, Jasmine Base Notes: Musk, Oakmoss, Ambergris, Vanilla .

Inspired by the exhilarating crispness of alpine air, Silver Mountain Water is a fresh and contemporary scent. With juicy citrus head notes and unfolding heart notes of tea and a salty ozonic note, this exhilarating perfume also draws on base notes of sandalwood and musks which leave an icy air of freshness to this uplifting and energizing unisex fragrance.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Neroli Heart Notes: Green Tea, Blackcurrant Bud Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk .

Inspired by the incredibly crafted longships, a centrepiece of the Viking Age and one of the greatest design feats of the ninth century. A symbol of voyage and undeniable perseverance, longships were carefully designed for the skilled seaman who embodied unbridled determination to conquer. This woody citrus fragrance features 80% natural ingredients including peppercorn, Indian sandalwood and Haitian vetiver. A valiant men’s fragrance that bottles the fearless spirit of boundless exploration for the modern man who goes against the grain.. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Pink Peppercorn Heart Notes: Peppercorn, Bulgarian Rose, Peppermint Indian Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver, Indian Patchouli, Lavandin Absolute .

French Lover (Known as Bois d'Orage in the USA) is bound to draw admirers in crowds: an authoritative blend of galbanum, bay rum, musk, incense and iris laced with pimento and cedar. Angelica seeds, already featured in Malle’s Angeliques Sous la Pluie, play a very different role in Pierre Bourdon’s French Lover where they impact a spicy, earthy piquancy to a warm, embraceable amber perfume. . Top Notes: Spices, Galbanum Heart Notes: Incense, Cedar, Angelica Base Notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver, White Musk .

The blue Florentine iris with its characteristic soft powdery fragrance has been used in perfumery since ancient times. Here, Pierre Bourdon pays homage with precious orris root enhanced with bergamot, orange, rosewood, ylang ylang, and magnolia. The lushly floral heart is further enriched with violet, lily of the valley and jasmine resting on a base of musk, vanilla and ambergris.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Orange, Palisander Rosewood, Ylang-Ylang, Carnation Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine, Lily, Violet, Rose, Aldehydes Base Notes: Iris, Musk, Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Ebony Tree, Vetiver .

Ralf Schwieger brings you the scent of a luxurious, waxy, rose-red lipstick. For those who are looking for something completely different and original in perfume. The illusion is created with lavish use of grapefruit, violet, ambrette and coriander on a sweet base of roses, iris, raspberry and heliotrope.. Aldehydes (first used by another great innovator, Coco Chanel, for her No.5 eighty years ago) give their characteristic sparkle, freshness and exuberance to this hot little number!. Top Notes: Raspberry and Grapefruit Heart Notes: Rose, Iris and Violet Base Notes: Heliotrope, Tonka, Ambrette and Coriander .

The heavenly scent of lilies is unaccountably rare in perfume. Edouard Flechier has magnificently filled that void with this entrancing and spectacular bouquet for a wedding, ball or romantic holiday.. Orange flowers and water lily are combined with a rich assortment of lilies, including the ginger lily and the Madonna. Touches of musk, angelicas and muguet de bois complete a fragrance fit for the angels.. Top Notes: Sea Water, Ginger Heart Notes: Angelica, Orange Blossom, Lotus, Lily Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk .

Dominic Ropion's sensational oud fragrance for Frederic Malle's Editions de Parfums is as stunning and magnificent as one would expect.. A dark enveloping scent wrought of agarwood, Turkish rose and amber: an audacious attempt - we believe entirely successful and triumphant - to create a "true" Eastern oud perfume. The Night is not oud adapted and tamed to please conventional Western tastes but a fragrance which displays this legendary oil as presented, worn and treasured in the Orient: raw, ferocious, shocking and dangerous.. Woody, spicy, tenacious and disturbingly animalic. The Night is a master class in perfumery, showcasing an ancient ingredient with the ultimate in modern olfactory savoir-faire.. Top Notes: Saffron Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Frankincense Base Notes: Sandalwood, Oud .

Another Ropion extravaganza – equally suitable for men and women.. Here the gifted Ropion uses the highest concentration of Haitian vetiver in any modern perfume and heightens the dark green, spicy effect with bergamot, pink pepper, nutmeg, oakmoss and myrrh.. An audacious, stylish masterpiece and without doubt a future classic of the perfumer’s art.. Notes: Bitter orange, vetiver, sandalwood, oakmoss, amber .

A smooth, rich, woody oriental fragrance of unctuous majestic opulence, inspired by the comfortable redolence of London gentlemen's clubs.. Expect plenty of honeyed pipe tobacco blended with the darkest Tahitian vanilla and the ambery woods of antique furniture. The fragrance pivots around a core of frankincense and olibanum; creamy sandalwood and indolic jasmine add dangerous sensuality leading the wearer into a deep hypnotic velvety trance, closed away from the world in a secluded seductive dream.. Top Notes: Sweet Pipe Tobacco Heart Notes: Jasmine, Amber, Resins Base Notes: Dark Woods, Frankincense, Vanilla . .

An exemplary take on oud, this scent begins with a lively blend of black pepper and candied mandarin, before unfolding into a bewitchingly dark heart of roses, orris and tea.. What makes Thirty Three truly remarkable, however, is the blend of ouds that lie at the base of it's composition, mainly a rare, vintage oud that has been aging since 1980 and boasts a remarkable dry quality. Truly one for connoisseurs! This highly lauded, exquisite oud fragrance is hand-blended in Marylebone, London.. Top Notes: Black pepper, Mandarin, Caoutchouc Heart Notes: White tea, Rose, Taif rose, Iris, Metallic notes Base Notes: Oud, Patchouli, Heliotrope .

Eau de Jean Claude Ellena. Intense strength due to a large proportion of natural Bigarade essence in the formula. This scent is characterised by it's long lasting, though natural smelling freshness which contrasts with the "technical smelling" fragrances one finds in today's market place. Luxurious in its apparent purity, like a crisp white shirt: minimal and transparent. Yet beneath, lies an undercurrent of mischief. A sense of warm skin tone and clear-cut sex appeal that unfolds as it lingers. For those who believe that seduction is found in cleanliness and perfection, here is a cologne designed to renew its wearer with every splash. An overdose of extremely refined bitter orange essence (bigarade), embellished with cardamom and pink pepper on a woody base of hay and cedar, heralds a new generation of "eaux". An ocean of sophisticated freshness.. Top Note: Bitter Orange Heart Note: Rose Base Notes: Cedar, Grass, Hay .

A wave of icy water is transposed here into a fragrance, enlivened by a citrusy wind. A souvenir of the master perfumer's trip to India, where the atmosphere is regularly refreshed with ginger-scented water, this citrusy composition with spicy notes reinvents the eau de cologne genre.. The composition borrows the rhizomes' vivid and intense notes, which mingle with the bergamot, neroli and petit grain accords with slightly floral nuances. At the heart of the fragrance, the SFE ginger extract obtained by CO2 extraction, which keeps intact the purity of its facets. An accord of fig leaf and cypress essence extends the ginger's freshness. A sober and audacious creation, as a dive into the ice water.. Top Notes: Calabrian bergamot, SFE ginger extract, Tunisian neroli, Petitgrain Heart Notes: Fig leaf, Cypress Base Notes: White woods .

This fragrance is a kind tribute by the master perfumer to vetiver, a noble root native to Haiti. Resolutely masculine, this raw material presents a very marked woody trail, which is easily recognizable. With Mythique Vétyver, Alberto Morillas has decided to highlight the most original facets of this ingredient, combining it with other notes that crown its strong character.. Its lively nuances, both citrus and bitter, are highlighted by an accord of lemon and bergamot. Its floral accents, which bring it surprisingly close to the rose, are evoked here by geranium, the "men's rose".. Finally, its dense and smoky facet is enhanced by notes of papyrus warmed by an amber woody accord of patchouli and cistus labdanum. Here, the Haitian vetiver is the undisputed protagonist, whilst the citrus, floral and woody notes are the guests of honour.. Top Notes: Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon Heart Notes: Bourbon geranium, Cistus labdanum absolute Base Notes: Papyrus, Haitian vetiver, Patchouli heart .

"This letter may not reach you. But it is meant for you, just like this perfume. Our eyes have only met once but to me, I have always known you". This fragrance is a tribute by master perfumer Alberto Morillas to an ephemeral, yet unforgettable encounter. On the train from Paris to Venice, a lady apologizes after brushing against the perfumer, who then seizes her profile, the curve of her eyelashes, the hem of her lips. A moment that becomes eternal, thanks to this resolutely nostalgic second-skin fragrance.. The softness of her voice, the elegance of her features, the grace of her gestures are translated here by the roundness of the most refined musks. Her velvety skin, by a sensual accord of sandalwood and vanilla. Her silhouette is thus outlined in the light, exquisite and harmonious like the scent of a white flower, which crowns the composition.. Top Notes: Orange blossom petal extract Heart Notes: Ambrox®, Paradisone®, Jasmine sambac Base Notes: Bourbon vanilla absolute, Exaltone®, Australian sandalwood .

An imaginary journey to the Indonesian island of Celebes, which opens all its abundance to our senses. A true daydream, carried by a unique escape fragrance, into the heart of an impenetrable jungle, rich and lush as its vegetation. The sun is at its zenith, the heat has been awakening the scents since the dawn, a profusion of bewitching essences seizes us from the forest. We advance step by step, the smells intensify: the burning cinnamon bark and the cardamom seeds merge with the woody scents of the forest. The power of white pepper, with its fiery notes, is rounded out by the black vanilla bean, slightly gourmand. Cold mingles with warm, followed by the roasted accents of tonka bean and the depth of labdanum. The intensity of these accords leaves its mark on our skin, like a memory of a distant journey that is still present. . Top Notes: Bergamot essence, Cardamom essence, Geranium essence Heart Notes: Cinnamon essence, Cistus labdanum essence, White pepper essence, Tonka bean absolute Base Notes: Styrax essence, Clearwood®, Madagascan vanilla absolute .

The last glimmers of the King Star cradle the only room still lit. Thus falls the twilight and the flame of the candles takes over. The atmosphere becomes soft, the subdued light takes on a fine golden powder. Just like a magician, master perfumer Alberto Morillas chose to capture these golden moments and transpose them into a fragrance. He therefore borrows from his olfactory palette the most luminous, comforting and timeless ingredients.. The paradisone merges here with the sunny sweetness of tiare flower. A powdery, almost tactile sensation is offered by a rare duo of musks and iris concrete. Sandalwood and vanilla over-absolute bring a round and bewitching depth. The perfumer's work therefore evokes the one of the alchemist, who balances his dosages to obtain the golden lightness proper to the evening light.. Top Notes: Tiare flower accord, Paradisone® Heart Notes: Exaltone®, Iris concrete Base Notes: Australian sandalwood, Vanilla over-absoulte .

Freeze frame. Heated by the embers, a few pieces of oud burn very slowly. In front of our eyes, the metamorphosis of an extraordinary wood which reveals all its depth. Nevertheless, this is only a vision. Master perfumer Alberto Morillas chose not to use the natural essence of the famous wood, while rather representing its olfactory memory. The emotions evoked by the memory of the embers that turn crimson, the fine volutes perfuming at once our body, the fabrics and our skin are therefore highlighted.. In this woody memory, the Alaskan cedar is the undisputed protagonist. Rarely used in perfumery, it gently reveals nuances of leather and incense. Refreshed by coriander and bergamot, it burns with cade wood. Incandescent and radical, it becomes rounder in contact with the floral notes of rose and iris. And the scroll finally becomes a scented trail.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Coriander, Bulgarian rose Heart Notes: Iris concrete, Oud accord Base Notes: Alaskan cedar, Cade essence .

In 1905, a lovestruck young woman named Mazie Coyle devised a scheme to break her fiancee out of prison that would later become legendary - a hacksaw baked into a wedding cake.. To celebrate love, ingenuity, and the pleasures of non-violently thumbing one's nose at the system, Ex Idolo presents Love & Crime, a delightfully bright floral gourmand with sass and style to spare. The scent is deceptively simple, a bold, lusciously romantic blend of rich vanilla and white florals, smooth, creamy and mouthwatering. A vibrant note of red mandarin shines in the opening, bestowing a fruity brightness to the richly sugared exterior. We're treated to both indulgent butteriness and, though a surprisingly dark, if subtle, note of cocoa, a hint of the illicit surprise within.. This is a scent meant to charm and delight, and Love & Crime accomplishes that goal as deftly as a perfectly timed prison break.. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Red Mandarin Heart Notes: White Florals, Sugar, Star Anise Base Notes: Cocoa, Vanilla .

A gorgeous fragrance to celebrate the glorious Italian summer and the 15th Anniversary of the deliciously elegant Eau d'Italie brand. Congratulations to all concerned - and a special round of applause for perfumer Dora Baghriche, creator of the new fragrance Easy to Love!. Easy to Love lives up to its name. It's a sparkling dewy green bouquet of enlivening luscious scents. Silky creamy peony petals brush against honey-comb and dark purple figs ; verdant fig leaves are brushed with ambrette seeds and mouth-watering sweet-sour white currants. In the background, the sound of a fountain, the chirp of cicadas and the splash of silver carp in a bottomless cool pool. The perfect holiday choice!. This is an Eau de Parfum.. Top Notes: White Currant, Fig Heart Notes: White Peony, Honey Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Ambrette Seeds .

A soft skin is lulled by the first rays of sunlight. While closing our eyes, the warmth of the summer light carries our body and mind into a deep sleep. The master perfumer Alberto Morillas conceived this fragrance as an elixir of musks, so powdery and enveloping that we dream of falling asleep with its caress. This composition has no top notes whatsoever. At the heart of the fragrance, an overdose of musks, sunny yet delicate, such as muscenone and habanolide, provide the perfume with a "second skin" effect. Iris concrete, intensely powdery, and vibrant amber woods, such as limbanol, reinforce the depth of the fragrance. Elixir de Musc is a scented cocoon that envelops us while letting us envelop itself. . No top note Heart notes: Iris concrete, Limbanol®, Habanolide® Base notes: Heliotrope, Muscenone®, Cetalox® .

This fragrance was born from the playful bet of master perfumer Alberto Morillas: to translate the perfume of a kiss. All the sensations we feel in a heartbeat when approaching the skin of the other are here transposed into a perfume. The intimacy between two faces, the warmth of the neck, the powdery fruity smell of a lipstick. All these moments radiate here in unison, as the details of a distant yet present memory.. The raspberry notes recalling the lipstick melt here with exaltone, a musk with a strangely human scent, as well as with cachalox, whose carnal voluptuousness is close to ambergris. Finally, the heart of benzoin and patchouli bring a deep softness, a nod to the sensuality of a cheek returning a caress. A perfume which pays tribute to the yesteryear's gesture of perfuming ourselves with musk as an invitation to love.. Top Notes: Raspberry, Exaltone® Heart Notes: Cachalox® Base Notes: Benzoin essence, Patchouli heart .

Seville, 1960. "Blossoming orange trees perfume the patio under the intense spring sun. A light breeze from the sea calls us to reach the beach, while vanilla ice cream awaits us in the shade." Thus the master perfumer Alberto Morillas describes the sunny moments spent in Spain during his childhood, lulled by a sun that was both powerful and comforting.. Paradisone and neroli evoke the notes of fresh water that was thrown on the hot tiles. Orange blossom and jasmine sambac are a tribute to the warm air saturated with perfumes, while vanilla over-absolute brings a gourmande sweetness. A mille-feuille of olfactory reminiscences concentrated around a soft and regressive orange blossom, barely sweet like a gourmandise from childhood.. Top Notes: Seville orange neroli essence, Paradisone® Heart Notes: Egyptian jasmine absolute, Egyptian orange blossom absolute Base Notes: Vanilla over-absolute .

An innovative perfume which goes straight to the heart of the matter. An olfactory evocation of obsessive passionate love, simple in construction but powerful in expression.. Rolling in Love is a musc de peau, capturing the sensation of feeling so high on love that it seems to almost “get under the skin”. Working with perfumer Pascal Gaurin, Kilian Hennessy took an entirely new direction. Rolling in Love is more direct and less faceted than his previous fragrances—almost “monochromatic” in its focused representation of a single emotion. Rolling in Love is a “white” scent, layering different textures along the scent’s trail with notes of ambrette seeds, almond milk, iris, and musk.. Top Notes: Ambrette Heart Notes: White Iris, Almond Milk Base Notes: Musk .

Iris Ebène was previously named Cuir d'Iris.. The roots of the iris plant are peeled by hand, washed, air-dried, and ultimately, after a long period of storage, distilled. It takes six years to produce the essence, which makes iris one of the most precious raw materials in perfumery.. Its delicate, powdery fragrance evokes shades of violet, mimosa and carrot with buttery and woody accents. Iris Ebène brings out the sensual, enveloping fragrance of iris in a blend of various woods, balsams and musks. The end result, a gentle, voluptuous, textured leather fragrance that yields a trail as comfortable and addictive as a cashmere sweater.. Top Notes: Red mandarin, Petitgrain mandarin, Allspice Heart Heart Notes: Pink pepper, Iris, Suede Bottom Notes: Balsam of Peru, Sandalwood, Leather musk .

Iris Ebène was previously named Cuir d'Iris.. The roots of the iris plant are peeled by hand, washed, air-dried, and ultimately, after a long period of storage, distilled. It takes six years to produce the essence, which makes iris one of the most precious raw materials in perfumery.. Its delicate, powdery fragrance evokes shades of violet, mimosa and carrot with buttery and woody accents. White cacao beans are a rare ancestral variety of cacao also known as the “Nectar of the Gods”. The beans are removed from the pods, fermented, then sun-dried and roasted.. White cacao yields sensuous notes of walnut and milk with hints of tonka bean. After opening on sweet, syrupy top notes, Cacao Porcelana unpacks its bitterness, sustained by powdery and woody notes. Light tobacco, patchouli and sandalwood scents give Cacao Porcelana a sensual, even fleshy signature.. Top Notes: White Cacao, Rum, Everlasting Flower Heart Notes: Indian Jasmine, Light Tobacco, Davana Base Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean .

A flutter of a butterfly's wings . This delightful candle is inspired by a legendary Irish love story that spanned a thousand years. Étaín is an enchanting flutter of fleshy tuberose and jasmine petals set against the woody gloam of cedar and patchouli. . Candle weighs 280g with burn time 55-60 hours.. Please note that Cloon Keen candles are not eligible for gift wrapping. . Top Notes: Pink Pepper Heart Notes: Jasmine, Tuberose Base Notes: Cedarwood Virginia, Patchouli, Amber .

A portrait of Spring .. Green almond trees in blossom, bluebells, hyacinths, spring flowers, rose, green grass, jasmine and tilia (linden blossom), L’Amandière has a complex structure that is full of life and intelligence. The result is like an olfactive interpretation of an imaginary Spring orchard in which everything is simultaneously in flower.. Top Notes: Green Almond, Jasmine, Rose, Hyacinth, Lime Blossom, Tilia Heart Notes: Floral Notes, Jasmine, Rose, Green Notes Base Notes: Grass, Hawthorne, Woods .

L’Homme À la Rose is Francis Kurkdjian’s free interpretation of a rose for men. In the first few seconds, very fresh, green and bursting notes paired with a grapefruit accord and essence of Damask rose from Bulgaria create a sensation of natural vitality. Then come the middle notes of a rosy, very woody accord, gradually enhanced by woody amber notes which infuse the sillage with sensuality. With this fresh, floral and bright eau de parfum, Francis Kurkdjian gives men the power to wear a rose.. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Damask Rose Heart Notes: Sage, Ambery Woods Base Notes: Centifolia Rose, Cistus Labdanum .

An elegant diffuser which imbues linens and spaces with a serene natural fragrance, to help promote a tranquil mind and restful sleep, essential for maintaining mood, metabolism and memory.. Olverum Pillow Mist expertly blends essential oils prized for their soothing qualities, and is designed to evoke sensations of comfort, calm and cleanliness. The sweet citrus notes of bergamot, the warm, rich woodiness of amyris, and the full-bodied fruitiness of potent high-altitude lavender combine to create a uniquely sumptuous and somniferous scent.. Olverum Pillow Mist is vegan and cruelty-free, free from artificial preservatives, fragrance and colourants, Silicone, Mineral Oil, Petrolatum, Sulphates, Phthalates, Parabens, Triclosan and animal derived ingredients..

A carefully crafted blend of essential oils and natural mineral salts formulated to revitalise skin, relax the mind and aid restful sleep. Olverum Bath Salts offer the soothing therapeutic benefits of Olverum’s signature Bath Oil, enriched with sustainably-sourced Dead Sea Salt and Kalahari Desert Salt.. Renowned sources of minerals and trace elements including magnesium, potassium, and calcium, these work in harmony with the body’s natural regeneration processes to help regulate cell repair, aid skin barrier function, and boost collagen and keratin levels, providing an intensively nourishing therapy for the whole body.. Dissolving in seconds, Olverum Bath Salts are further enhanced with Vitamin E, and deep-penetrating avocado oil, an abundant source of antioxidants, vitamins, and Omega 9, which replenish moisture, leaving skin feeling velvety-smooth, and both body and mind revived.. Olverum Bath Salts are vegan and cruelty-free, free from artificial preservatives, fragrance and colourants, Silicone, Mineral Oil, Petrolatum, Sulphates, Phthalates, Parabens, Triclosan and animal derived ingredients..

A cool and fragrant cocktail of a fragrance conceived in clear glassy colours: the waxen frosty pink of juniper berries, the delicate blush of Rosa Centifolia, the pale green of cucumber and the acidic tints of lime. All this is shaken up on cracked ice crystals like a glorious martini with a dash of citrus : Madame Kilian’s aperitif of choice!. Working with perfumer Frank Voelkl on their first collaboration, Kilian has produced a fabulous and fragrant interpretation of the finest aromatic gin blended with oils of cucumber and roses. This classic combination of scents goes back at least to Tudor times but here it is interpreted in the most modern, stylish and sophisticated manner. Roses on Ice is a superlative party perfume which progresses in mood from crackling ice to the soft dry warmth of musks and sandalwood.. Top Notes: Cucumber, Juniper Berries Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk .

A beautiful and very Gallic concept: “la part des anges” is the small proportion of brandy or cognac which evaporates from the cask as the spirit matures. Away it goes: straight up to Heaven.... What’s left for us is this glorious fragrance by Kilian and perfumer Benoit Lapouza. Angels' Share has all kinds of deep emotional resonance with Kilian whose family have been legends of the cognac industry for 8 generations. The Hennessy clan recognise that the conception and crafting of a sublime cognac has much in common with the creation a superb perfume: the selection of ingredients, the blending, the patient maturation.. Angels' Share is built around true cognac essence derived from the liquor, to give the perfume a rich and natural dark caramel colour. Spices, precious woods and vanilla offer a truly ambrosial gustatory and olfactory experience: a perfume in which the senses of taste and smell mingle in ecstasy.. Top Notes: Cognac Heart Notes: Oak Absolute, Cinnamon Essence, Tonka Bean Absolute Base Notes: Sandalwood, Praline, Vanilla .

Kingdom Botanica is a glorious expansive perfume which marks 350 years since the establishment of the Royal Botanic Garden of Edinburgh. The fragrance celebrates the history and significance of the Garden, its stockists, creators and curators.. A rich and ample green woody floral , Kingdom Botanica honours the Garden’s role in world horticultural conservation and plant research. Oils from over thirty five natural and sustainable ingredients celebrate the beauty and excitement of our planet’s magnificent and abundant biodiversity.. Kingdom Botanica is an historic fragrance which evokes the scents of three continents, besides honouring the pioneering explorers who first brought the plants home to the Athens of the North. Welcome to the Temple of Flora!. Top Notes: Pink pepper, Spiced Chinese Plum Blossom, Blackcurrant Stems and Buds, Pine Needles, Green Botanical Accord Heart Notes: Exotic White Floral Accord, Jasmine, Ginger Lily, Sweet Myrrh, Frankincense Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli, Vetiver, White Musk, Amber .

Everyone wants a practical no-fuss lightweight compact perfume atomiser that you can take anywhere - and which will not leak!. We’ve found the very one. Light, durable, airtight and airline-approved for hand baggage. An atomiser you can take anywhere. What’s more it’s made entirely of aluminium: now there is no glass to crack, shatter or damage. You can pop this neat and handy little device into your pocket, bag or suitcase with confidence and assurance.. The Travalo Milano holds 5ml of any fragrance of your choice - that’s approximately 65 x sprays of a fine perfume mist. For most people that’s enough scent to last comfortably for several days: it will certainly see you through a long holiday weekend. So now there’s no need to clutter your luggage with large clunky bottles.. The Travalo Milano is superbly strong, practical and handy. Thanks to its innovative neat pump system you don’t have to fiddle around with funnels to transfer perfume from bottle to atomiser. Consequently there’s no spillage, dripping or fuss and no exposure to the air. It’s like an answer to a prayer!.

B683 is now available as an extrait. If this fragrance were a man, it would materialise as Cary Grant. The huge popularity and success of this beautiful scent has encouraged Barrois and perfumer Quentin Bisch to create a very intense and sensual parfum strength of B683. Rich, dark and as smooth as velvet, this exceedingly tenacious and seductive fragrance is made up to a very powerful 40% concentration for maximum effect and irresistible sillage.. The original formula has been re-orchestrated with oud to give extra depth and effect. Whether in eau de parfum or in extrait strength, B683 is a creation which defines supreme elegance and savoirfaire for the modern generation.. Top Notes: Black pepper, Chilli, Nutmeg, Saffron Heart Notes: Musk, Cistus, Vanilla tincture, Violet leaf, Amber Base Notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Oud, Oak moss, Sandalwood .

A glorious explosion of purple, mauve, lilac and blue: the endless vista of the lavender fields of Provence, captured by perfumer Michel Almairac. Haute Provence / 89 is a universal memory of France in high summer: vast blue fields shimmering beneath a limitless azure sky.. Cool accords of watermelon refresh the dry silver lavender leaves; while the heavy aromatic flower heads are intensified by a note of hypnotic narcissus. All the nostalgic charm and bucolic freshness of lavender is spread out like a fragrant herbal carpet.. Top Notes: Watermelon Heart Notes: Lavender, Narcissus Base Notes: Scented Woods .

500 years ago in the beautiful city of Florence the art of perfuming leather was perfected. Scented leather clothes and accessories became the must-have requisites for leaders of fashion all over Europe. Perfumed gloves especially caught the public imagination, a trend popularised by amateur parfumeuse Catherine de’ Medici, the colossally rich Florentine girl who became the powerful and sinister Queen of France. Some said the gloves she offered as gifts were not only perfumed but poisoned.. The animalic indolic accords of jasmine oil - plus its intense florality - makes it a piquant and classic combination with the scent of smooth soft supple leather. Elegant, deeply sensual and erotic Jasmine Leather is a stunning creation to grace any occasion. Its echoes of the past give it extra panache and glamour.. This is an Eau de Parfum.. Top Notes: Elemi, saffron Heart Notes: Jasmine, leather Base Notes: Patchouli, cedar wood .

Introducing Atacama, exclusive to Les Senteurs.. In South America, beyond the Northwest Argentine border, lies Atacama, the highest desert on earth, a majestic extension of salt and sands which changes colour according to the seasons.. Rain is scarce - Atacama is said to be the driest place on earth - but it just takes a few drops to awaken the seeds which patiently await underground and turn it pink with flowers.. A beautiful metaphor for Love patiently awaiting the kiss that kindles it.... Perfumer Fabrice says: "I translated the magic of the flowers blooming in the salty Argentinian desert, playing with delicate freesia notes, contrasted with the sparkling facets of salt grains." . Top Notes: Salt Grains, Freesia Heart Notes: Jasmine, Clary Sage Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Cashmere Wood .

In the lexicon of magic, perfume is the greatest spell of all.. The longest spell in the ancient Egyptian Book of the Dead, Spell 125 covers the ceremonial process of crossing the underworld to reach the afterlife, including the famous weighing of the heart ceremony, where only a feather-light heart would pass the Gods' test.. Liz made her perfumery debut with Anubis, that dark and bewitching tribute to the jackal-headed god Anubis, guardian of the tombs and desert cemeteries. While Spell 125 steps away from the scorched tar notes that can be found in Anubis, it follows the concept from Papillon's first perfume and brings the wheel full circle.. Liz sourced arcane and precious ingredients: green frankincense purifies and elevates. Precious woods from the old world and the new combine with white ambergris to conjure a dark rich mystery.. This is a necromantic enchanter’s fragrance that propels your body into ecstasy and your heart into the heavens.. Top Notes: Ylang, Black Hemlock Heart Notes: Siberian Pine, Green Sacra Frankincense Base Notes: Indian Sandalwood, White Ambergris .

Musk, amber and sandalwood elevate the delicate layers of rose, that once airborne leave a distinctive trail of scent and secret admirers.. listings.rawTitle: Apple Brandy on the Rocks 50ml EDP
listings.description: Inspired by the city of New York, Kilian Paris introduces its new addition to the Liquors olfactive family: Apple Brandy on the Rocks, an olfactive soundtrack to nightlife’s liberation to come. Apple Brandy was first conceived with perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur for the opening of Kilian Paris’ New York flagship eight years ago. The fragrance returns, featuring the original apple brandy core but, this time, with an added uplift - Kilian Paris' “on the rocks” accord blended into the opening for an ice-cold liquored delight expressing a uniquely Kilian Paris character. A blend of bergamot, apple brandy and cardamom, the accord cools down the original, adding excitement and modernity.. This fresh opening of Apple Brandy on the Rocks unfolds into the perfume’s core personality: a distinctive apple brandy accord, in which a crisp fruity blend harmonizes with brandy - recreated using notes of rum for the liquor aspect, moss and vanilla. Upon a core structure of cedarwood and ambroxan, the scent carries sophistication into the night. It captures the constant reincarnation and incontestable elegance of the ‘Big Apple’- most especially that of its legendary nightlife.. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur. Top Notes: Bergamot Heart Notes: Apple Brandy Base Notes: Cardamom .

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. The idea for this candle fragrance came from a story told by Betty Hawksley. Michael and Betty were travelling to the South of France on ‘Le Train Bleu’. It would be the first time he would be introduced to Betty’s maternal grandparents, and his first visit in Toulon. As the train made its way along the coastal track, Michael leaned his body out of the window, inhaled deeply several times and exclaimed ‘Oh Betty, can you smell this?.... this scent, it's just so… incredible!’ . ‘On the night train heading south, full of anticipation; the dawn breaks and the sun-warmed scents of the Mediterranean flow through the open window.’ .

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. Betty’s mother lived as a small child in Madagascar. As we investigated, we learned of this unique island’s rich and abundant natural resources and the possible scientifically beneficial potential of its flora.. There are stories that pirates founded their own anarchist colony in Madagascar, which they named Libertalia. On Libertalia, the pirates supposedly created a new language and operated a socialist economy..

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. The idea for this fragrance came from Claire Hawksley's memory of visiting the southern hemisphere for the first time. She'd been escaping from a particularly negative relationship but in the garden’s night air her mind was completely refocused by the scent of the night blooms.. ‘The full moon illuminates the soft white petals of tropical flora like stars in a darkening sky. .

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. The original idea was based around Michael’s parents' family home in Loos, Kent. They, like many families in the area, had a small garden cherry orchard. Come harvest time, all would gather together to help bring in the cherry crop.. 'The golden afternoon fades in the ancient orchard; the harvest is long completed. Beneath the boughs, plucked of their wares, only the discarded pips remain. Gathered like magic stones and counted by the light of the bonfire, they foretell what future might come…’ .

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. This scent was inspired by an old black and white photograph of Maimie, a great friend of the family, and second mother to Michael..

Les Senteurs’ first candle collection is inspired by the history of the Hawksley and Nicholson families, who came together as Michael and Betty Hawksley – the co-founders of Les Senteurs.. The inspiration for this candle was a spectacular winter holiday in Vermont. It couldn’t have been more magical; a log cabin, mountains, deep crisp snow, all the family assembled, and an inglenook fireplace around which to warm oneself.. 'A forest cabin offers refuge from the elements. Tranquil silence but for the sounds of the wild woods and the glowing hearth. Wrapped in comfort; focus fixed. Total shared contentment’. .

Surrender to the darkness of the night with a boozy cocktail and a good dose of velvety smoky happiness with the last sun on your cheeks.. "My mother, she was an anomaly, she was brilliant, she was loved but she paid a huge price." - from an Interview with Lisa Simone, in What Happened Miss Simone? . "I’m sorry, Dave, I’m afraid I can’t do that. I am putting myself to the fullest possible use, it can only be attributable to human error. This conversation can serve no purpose anymore. Goodbye." - HAL 9000 iconic quote in 2001: A Space Odyssey. . These remarks could summarize our new perfume, a marriage of Nina Simone and Stanley Kubrick. This fragrance is dedicated to them, to celebrate their talents, their deviations from the norm, from the theoretical value, from the expected. This disparity comes with an excess, from a 'computer malfunction', forcing the dose on the iris and musk, and this sublime jeopardy has sprung up to become a perfume, carved by Daniela Andrier. A singularity. A difference. This perfume was necessary.. - Etienne De Swardt . “This perfume is the result of something unexpected. I played with Carto, Givaudan’s AI-powered tool for suggesting formulas. I gave it beloved and familiar notes. Carto suggested an overdose of two ingredients. I took care of the rest.. - Daniela Andrier, perfumer (Givaudan) . Top Notes: Green Tangerine Heart Notes: Vanilla-Orchid Accord, Prunes Neo Jungle Essence™, Incense Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Amberfix©.

The first fragrance from this house 'Lahore' marks the city of the perfumer's father. A city full of culture and warmth, a city with many layers and facets and a fascinating history. The scent therefore has been curated with the name in mind. Opening with saffron and pushing through with woody notes Lahore is a fragrance for any occasion. The addition of pure Assam Aoud and Samrat Aoud allows for the magic of this ingredient to transport one as far as the olfactory system will allow.. Labdanum graces the scent body and texture. A hint of combined with some beautiful musks make up the base.. Welcome to Lahore. Welcome to Opulence.. Top Notes: Saffron, Pink Pepper, Cinnamon Heart Notes: Hay Base Notes: Patchouli, Cypriol, Vetiver, Leather, Vanilla, Labdanum, Amber, Benzoin, Oud .

Inspired by movement, Wind Flowers is the latest women's perfume from the House of Creed. Floral and fresh, this fragrance opens with sweet jasmine, wrapped around the zesty scent of Tunisian orange blossom and softened by a fresh and a fruity peach note, a powerful heart of delicate jasmine flower, tuberose petals and a soft rose extract add depth and texture to this fragrance while a warm flurry of sandalwood is twisted around a haze of iris and musk. Inspired by the old story of the Celtic horse, Énbarr, the new fragrance embodies the drama and magic of the myth, a perfumer’s interpretation of passion and speed; hooves clattering through history; wild manes flowing on a fragrant wind of spring on fields of fennel, thyme, and geranium.. Énbarr is an intoxicating but modern oud with an anisic signature. At its heart, full-blown geranium and saffron carry groomed oud and billowing saddler’s leather . A purple mantle of wild thyme and fennel provides an irresistible beat to its voluptuous heart. . Sensual notes of tobacco flower and vanilla blend with hints of patchouli, cardamom and basil in a scent that swirls with rich, delicate spices, enveloping your senses and feeding the soul.. "The scent we love the most - it has note of vanilla bean and hints of patchouli, cardamom, nutmeg and basil but what ties it most with the Tropics is the sensual tone of tobacco flower." - Country & Townhouse . Top Notes: Bergamot, Nutmeg, Cardamom, Basil Heart Notes: Tobacco Flower, Rose Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Amber, Cedarwood, Tonka .

Inspired by the romance of travel; long summer evenings in the tropics; memories of passion, adventure and romance, Cochine's fragrances are expertly blended in France with the finest oils. Each scent sweeps you away on a voyage of discovery, infusing your senses with an inspiring sense of escape, wherever you may be..

Location: Tanzania, Zanzibar.. “Sorting through my diary has brought back a plethora of fond memories of my visit to Zanzibar. It had the most exquisite, powdery, white sand beach I’ve ever laid foot on. I took countless dips in the shimmering, warm, turquoise waters, and the sunset encounters were nothing short of breathtaking.”. This is an Extrait de Parfum.. Top Notes: Lime, Red Mandarin, Pink Pepper, Mint Heart Notes: Coconut, Guava, Cassis Base Notes: Musk Cocktail, Candied Fruits, Ambergris, Transparent Oud, Moss .

Fresh jungle on the side of a volcano, ENCELADE is a powerful and captivating perfume.. Shadow-light relationship within a perfume which plays its paradoxes with delight.. Main accord of rhubarb, cedar and vetiver express the smell of Earth, sap, lush nature. Green and woody notes which comes to mingle with the crash of smoked and animal leather.. Milky sandalwood and tonka bean add sensuality and addiction to the skin.. Pure seduction of a perfume conveying a wild magnetism.. Top Notes: Rhubarb Heart Notes: Vetiver, Atlas cedar Base Notes: Tonka bean, Australian sandalwood .

Location: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.. Follow the trail out of the sea of desert and into the region of grasslands, hills and mountains. Hera is a celebratory bouquet of floral notes. It is altogether modern but with a subtle nod to vintage fragrances of a bygone era, a creative style that Papillon has become well known for.. "Hera is the perfume that I created for my eldest daughter to wear on her wedding day. Originally intended to be only for her exclusive use, my daughter Jasmine insisted that she would love to share Hera with the rest of the world. It is a perfume that I am inordinately proud of, especially as I was able to include some of mine and my daughters favourite perfume materials, and because of the sentiment attached to the creation." - Liz Moores . Top Notes: Jasmine, Orange blossom, Bergamot, Heliotrope, Clary Sage Heart Notes: Ambrette, Rose de Mai, Turkish Rose, Orris, Narcissus, Ylang Ylang Base Notes: Vanilla, Labdanum and Musk.

Rather than cognac itself, VSOP recreates an impossibly seductive setting in which it is being drunk. A green citrus top note melts into a simmering warm base of spices, woods, musks and a cognac accord.. "You don't have to like drinking cognac, nor will you smell as if it has been dabbed about your person. VSOP is the romance of when you might drink a glass; a toast to special moments with those dear to you; warm and contented." - Tom Daxon . Top Notes: Bergamot, Geranium, Cognac Heart Notes: Elemi, Pink Pepper, Black Pepper, Ginger, Cinnamon Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Cashmeran, Warm Musks.
